jobs.title: (Senior) Product Manager - Customer Taxation (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

Raisin helps customers grow their wealth through savings and investments without barriers. But even the best products and the smoothest experience lose their value if customers pay more tax than they need to, or have to work out, declare and settle their taxes themselves. The Customer Taxation Team makes sure they don’t.  We design how tax works in Raisin’s tax-advantaged products, a growing part of our offer. Examples include the new Raisin Cash ISA in the UK and the Raisin Kinderdepot, a children’s investment account that uses the child’s tax allowances automatically. We also calculate and withhold tax on the interest and returns customers earn, handle their tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates, and provide the annual tax documents they need for their tax return. And we send the tax reports that authorities require. 

Raisin is available in many European countries, each with its own tax rules and reporting duties. As new regulations come to our platform, we make sure Raisin complies. You will lead a cross-functional team and work closely with Legal, Compliance, Country Management, Product Operations, Customer Service, Data, and external tax and banking partners. Our goal is for customers to trust that their tax is right, find it easy to manage, use the tax allowances they are entitled to, and have peace of mind.


Your Responsibilities

  • You will own a regulated domain that customers depend on every tax year. Working with an experienced Engineering Lead, you will become the go-to expert for customer taxation at Raisin.
  • Own customer taxation end to end: Define the vision and roadmap together with Product and Engineering leadership. Take each topic from discovery to delivery to measured impact. Decide what we build first, and keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, risks and trade-offs.
  • Keep tax accurate and reliable: Agree with Legal, Compliance and country managers on what correct looks like. Work with Engineering so calculation, documents and reporting stay stable and easy to extend.
  • Grow Raisin’s tax proposition: Shape how tax works when Raisin enters new markets, launches tax-advantaged products or brings on new partners. Find where we can take tax work off customers’ hands, so they don’t have to declare and settle it themselves.
  • Turn complex rules into simple experiences: Translate the  tax rules behind each launch into clear requirements with the edge cases covered. Design the customer experience and see the work through to delivery.
  • Hit the deadlines that cannot move: Make sure annual tax documents and statutory reports go out correct and on time, working with Product Operations. Plan backwards from fixed dates and monitor data quality.
  • Catch errors before they reach customers, and escalate early when a date is at risk.
  • Make tax effortless for customers: Keep self-service for tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates intuitive, so customers get them right the first time. Give Customer Service the tools to answer tax questions fast, especially around tax season.
  • Shape the team culture: Give and ask for feedback openly, share wins with the team, and treat mistakes as a reason to fix the process.

Your Profile

Must haves:

  • 3+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a technical product such as a back-end, platform or data-heavy service.
  • Experience leading a cross-functional product team and getting engineers and stakeholders behind shared priorities.
  • Experience launching new products or taking products into new markets, with the precision to get every edge case right, because one wrong tax rule can affect thousands of customers.
  • Strong analytical skills and the habit of checking and reconciling numbers yourself.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Agents
jobs.description:
Product Manager, Agents 
 London, 4x days per week in-office
 
 Vega is looking for A-players who will define and build the next generation of Agentic products that will shape the next era of private markets.
 
 About Vega 
 Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.
 
 Vega built the industry’s first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done - from the start of an investor’s journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it’s also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right.
 
 Who we are 
 We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world’s leading technology and financial services firms - including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo, Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do.
 
 How we do it 
 Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you:
 We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted.

 We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.

 We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.

 We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego.

 We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5.

 We know that this culture won’t be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.
 
 Who succeeds in this role 
 We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further.
 
 In this role, you will:
 Lead and partner with engineering teams on technical concepts to deliver exceptional AI-first solutions. Prototype instead of writing specs.

 Own an agentic surface end-to-end and decide what runs unattended and what needs a human.

 Keep every autonomous action explainable and reversible. Own the tradeoffs on reliability, latency and cost.

 Sit with GP and LP ops teams, find the manual work, remove it without breaking their controls.

 Operate and deliver with a sense of urgency under ambiguous situations in a fast-paced environment where multi-tasking, strong communication and problem-solving skills are a must.

 
 What we look for: 
 2+ years in product, ideally somewhere where being wrong is expensive.

 Hands-on with prompting, context engineering and evals. You've done it yourself, not managed someone who did.

 You've shipped LLM or agent features to real users, and can say what broke.

 Enough technical fluency to argue with engineers about retrieval and tool design. Good judgement to know when AI is the wrong answer.

 Working with GPs/LPs and/or knowledge of Fund administration, KYC/AML or LP portals is an advantage.

 
 Why join us? 
 You will help define the transformation of one of the most influential industries of our time with AI, working alongside an ambitious and dedicated team

 Competitive salary and equity package

 Benefits including medical insurance, gym membership, learning budget, and more

jobs.title: Team Lead Manager - Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Our Mission:
 Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.
 Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.
 Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.
 Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.
 
 Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here .
 
 What We’re Looking For

 We’re looking for highly technical engineers who want to lead and manage one of our engineering teams. It took over 10,000 interviews to hire our first 50 Omneans, and we’re now growing from 11 to more than 14 engineering teams in the coming months. Over the next year, our engineering team will double in size, our enterprise customer base will grow from ~180 to 300+, and revenue will triple.
  
 As a Team Lead Manager, you’ll lead a small team of engineers. You’ll set its technical direction, line-manage and grow the people in it, and stay hands-on in the code. This is not a hands-off management role: our teams are small, and you’ll be one of the strongest engineers on yours. You’ll partner closely with a Product Manager and Product Designer to decide what to build, and you’ll be accountable for how well it’s built and how fast it ships.
  
 If you’re a strong Tech Lead who hasn’t managed people yet, we’d still love to hear from you. You can start as a Team Lead, with management handled by an Engineering Manager, and grow into the full role with our support.
  
 What Can You Expect As a Team Lead Manager?

 Lead and Manage a Small Team. Line-manage the engineers on your team, run 1:1s, give feedback, and help them take on bigger problems.

 Stay Deeply Technical. You’ll still build. Expect to spend a meaningful share of your time writing code, reviewing PRs, and unblocking the hardest technical problems.

 AI-Native Development. AI is core to how we build. Engineers use Claude, Code, and agentic workflows every day, and our product is built on AI agents that automate complex procurement workflows. You’ll set the bar for how your team uses them.

 Customers at the Center. Talk directly with customers to understand their problems, and make sure your team builds things that create real value for them.

 Own Technical Direction. Make the architecture and design calls for your team’s problem space, and own the trade-offs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability.

 Work with Modern Technology. TypeScript across the stack, React, Postgres, and AWS serverless (Lambda, DynamoDB, EventBridge), managed through Pulumi and deployed via GitHub Actions. Datadog, Meticulous, and Incident.io round it out.

 Shape the Roadmap. Work with your PM and Designer on prioritisation, scoping, and sequencing so the team ships what matters most.

 Build the Team. Interview, hire, and onboard new engineers as we double in size.

  
 About You

 You’re a highly technical full-stack engineer. You’ve designed and shipped web apps end to end in TypeScript, ideally on AWS serverless, and you’re still one of the strongest engineers in the room.

 You’ve led engineers. You’ve been a Tech Lead, Team Lead, or TLM, owning delivery and technical direction for a team.

 You want to manage people, or grow into it. Ideally, you’ve line-managed engineers already. If not, you’re keen to learn.

 You still love to build. Leading hasn’t pulled you away from the code, and you want a role where you keep shipping.

 You raise the bar. You know what well-architected, reliable software looks like, and you help others get there through reviews, pairing, and clear feedback.

 You’re motivated by customer impact. You care about outcomes for customers, not just output, and you make good calls on what to build and what to cut.

 You’re a strong partner. You work well with product and design, push back when it matters, and bring people with you.

 You’re comfortable with ambiguity. You can take an unclear problem, shape it, and get a team moving on it.

  
 Nice-to-Haves

 You’ve led a team through fast growt

jobs.title: Chef.fe de Projet Hôpitaux / Project Manager Hospital
jobs.description:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.
 Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.
 Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.
 
 
 ⚡ Notre équipe Customer Operations 
 L’équipe Customer Operations accompagne les établissements de santé dans le déploiement et l’usage des solutions Lifen. Son travail conditionne une adoption durable : comprendre l’organisation de chaque client, coordonner les parties prenantes et faire avancer les projets jusqu’à leur mise en service.
 En tant que Project Manager, tu piloteras des déploiements auprès de grands comptes, notamment des groupements hospitaliers de territoire (GHT). Tu seras le point de repère côté Lifen pour structurer le projet, donner de la visibilité aux clients et lever les obstacles avec les équipes internes.
 
 
 🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous 
 Cartographier les établissements, les services concernés et leurs besoins pour cadrer chaque déploiement.

 Construire le planning projet, poser les jalons et suivre leur avancement.

 Animer les réunions de suivi et formaliser les décisions.

 Coordonner Business Development, Customer Operations, Ops Manager et R&D.

 Suivre les usages après le déploiement et identifier les difficultés rencontrées sur le terrain.

 Centraliser les bugs et demandes d’évolution, puis communiquer sur les corrections et nouveautés.

 Tenir la documentation projet à jour et contribuer à faire évoluer les méthodes et processus de l’équipe.

 
 
 ⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons 
 Must-have
 Une solide expérience dans la gestion de projets, idéalement dans le déploiement de logiciels ou de solutions numériques.

 Une bonne connaissance fonctionnelle et technique du secteur de la santé et de l’organisation d’un établissement de santé.

 Des bases en interopérabilité, en flux de données et en FHIR.

 La capacité à cadrer en autonomie des projets simples, suivre un calendrier, identifier les blocages et solliciter son manager lorsque nécessaire.

 Une communication écrite et orale claire auprès de clients comme d’équipes internes.

 Nice-to-have
 Une expérience auprès de grands comptes hospitaliers ou de groupements d’établissements de santé.

 Une connaissance des enjeux techniques liés à l’architecture d’une plateforme logicielle et aux intégrations entre systèmes.

 L’habitude de former des utilisateurs sur des outils ou processus fonctionnels.

 Une bonne maîtrise de Notion, des outils Google ou Office et d’outils de suivi de projet.

 Soft skills
 Tu sais organiser ton travail sans attendre qu’on te donne chaque prochaine étape, tout en signalant rapidement les risques ou les dépendances. Tu aimes comprendre le fonctionnement concret d’un client avant de proposer une solution. Face à des interlocuteurs aux priorités différentes, tu gardes le cap, tu reformules et tu fais avancer les décisions.
 
 
 Nos valeurs
 Embrace Complexity : tu prends le temps de comprendre les contraintes d’un établissement, les dépendances techniques et les besoins des utilisateurs.
 Bienveillance : tu communiques avec clarté, écoutes les difficultés et cherches des solutions avec les parties prenantes.
 Real Impact : tu veilles à ce que les solutions déployées soient réellement utilisées et facilitent le travail des professionnels de santé.
 
 
 👥 Process de recrutement 
 Échange avec Laura, Talent Acquisition - 30 min. Un premier échange pour comprendre ton parcours, tes attentes et ta motivation pour le poste.

 Entretien avec Loïc, Hiring Manager - 45 min. Une première rencontre avec ton potentiel futur manager qui approfondira ton expérience de gestion de projet et de déploiement, ta compréhension des environnements de santé et ta connaissance fonctionnelle des produits déployés.

 Étude de cas avec Loïc et un membre de l’équipe Customer Ops - 60 à 90 min. Quelques jours avant l’échange, nous t’enverrons une étude de cas à préparer. jobs.title: Scientific Product Manager
jobs.description:
About CuspAI 
 CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

 We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us. 
 
 The Role 
 Due to rapid growth in our partner lab network, we are seeking a Scientific Product Manager to join our Product team and bring partner labs and their experimental workflows onto the CuspAI platform.
 
 Your impact 
 This is an exciting opportunity to join the product team at CuspAI, working closely with materials scientists, ML researchers and platform engineers to make AI-driven experimentation work in real laboratories. As one of a small team of Scientific Product Managers, you will take ownership of a set of partner labs and the lab integration work around them, translating what each lab actually needs into requirements our engineers and ML researchers can build against. Alongside the product work, you will spend real time with your partners' teams and their experimental data.
 
 What You Will Do 
 Product Requirements & Roadmap 
 Shape and prioritise the roadmap for how experimental data, protocols and campaigns get into the CuspAI platform, together with your fellow Scientific Product Managers, the engineering lead and the wider product team.

 Write requirements, specifications and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from, covering experiment types, instrument integrations and LIMS/ELN connections, and work with the data team on the underlying data models and provenance.

 Contribute to decisions on what we build, what we integrate, and what we leave to partners' existing systems.

 Partner Lab Onboarding 
 Lead technical discovery with the partner labs you take on: map their workflows, instruments, sample logic and data systems, and pin down the true experimental unit and the parameters that matter.

 Own onboarding for your partner labs from scoping to the first closed-loop campaign, and turn each onboarding into reusable patterns and documentation shared across the team so the next one is faster.

 Act as the main scientific counterpart for the partner labs you look after, and represent the product in partner meetings, workshops and conferences.

 Closed-Loop Campaigns 
 Work with ML researchers to design optimisation campaigns (e.g. Bayesian optimisation) that respect real experimental constraints such as throughput, noise and failed samples.

 Define how platform-driven campaigns are validated, including benchmarks against manual or legacy workflows, success metrics and the evidence we bring to partners.

 
 Must Have Skills and Qualifications: 
 PhD in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, Chemical Engineering or a related experimental discipline, or equivalent experience in scientific research.

 Hands-on experience with high-throughput or automated experimentation (e.g. robotic synthesis, combinatorial libraries, automated characterisation, or self-driving / closed-loop labs) in industry, a national lab or research institute, or academia.

 Proven track record of translating scientific or process needs into requirements for engineers, software teams or automation vendors, and of validating that what was built works in the lab.

 Firsthand understanding of how experimental data is produced and where it fails: which metadata and provenance matter, instrument quirks, data quality issues, and what makes a dataset usable for machine learning.

 Depth in at least one materials domain (e.g. semiconductors and thin films including photovoltaics, catalysis and electrochemistry, energy materials including batteries, polymers and formulations, or separations and surfaces) and the curiosity to work across others.

 Working knowledge of Python for data handling and analysis; comfortable working with APIs and data schemas.

 Strong communicator and a proven collaborator, comfortable working directly with external partner labs as well as multidisciplinary science, ML, product and engineering teams.

 
 Bonus Points (But Not Critical): 
 Direct experience with closed-loop optimisation in an automated setting, such as Bayesian optimisation, active learning or design of experiments.

 Experience with research data management, LIMS/ELN systems, FAIR

jobs.title: Product Owner - Mobile Integrations (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime , we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually
 Creating solutions that run on 13% of the world’s smartphones 
 The Mobile Integrations team builds the core technology that turns advertising from an interruption into a rewarded experience for 770 million users. We own the robust, lightweight, integration layer between our ad engine and the global mobile ecosystem, ensuring our technology operates with minimal overhead while reaching a massive portion of the smartphone market.
 On the client side, our technology performs smoothly across 20 million daily SDK initializations. We build native Swift and Kotlin SDKs optimized for ms initialization and minimal binary overhead, with Unity, Flutter, and React Native wrappers that provide a unified API across the entire mobile ecosystem. Behind the scenes, a high-throughput Go and DynamoDB architecture handles the real-time state synchronization of millions of concurrent sessions. When your code runs on nearly one out of every seven smartphones on Earth, every millisecond of execution and every byte of memory counts.
 What you Will Do: 
 Own and prioritize the Mobile SDK product backlog, balancing customer needs, business priorities, technical requirements, and engineering capacity.

 Translate product and developer needs into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and actionable priorities for the engineering team.

 Drive feature delivery from discovery and planning through development, testing, release, and post-launch evaluation.

 Work closely with Android, iOS, Backend, QA, and other stakeholders to manage dependencies, resolve blockers, and ensure smooth delivery.

 Gather and analyze feedback from customers, developers, and internal teams to identify integration pain points and opportunities to improve the SDK and developer experience.

 Support SDK releases and rollouts, including release planning, documentation, adoption tracking, and communication with relevant stakeholders.

 Use product data, SDK telemetry, and feedback to measure outcomes, identify opportunities, and continuously improve the Mobile SDK platform.

 Who You Are: 
 You bring 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Product Owner in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. (Bonus points if you have a background in ad-tech or Mobile/SDKs) 

 You aren't expected to write code, but you are right at home discussing SDK architecture. You grasp the fundamentals and differences between iOS and Android, empowering you to have meaningful debates with the development team and properly weigh technical debt against business value.

 You have a proven track record of leveraging A/B testing and experimentation to drive product strategy. You know exactly how to define clear success metrics, analyze KPIs, and confidently pivot based on what the data tells you.

 You are a digital native who speaks the language of both business and engineering fluidly. You excel at closing the gap, aligning what the business envisions with what the technology can actually execute.

 You take deep ownership of your product. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, working independently, and making the objective calls needed to balance incoming business requests with the long-term technical integrity of the platform.

 You possess concise, direct communication skills. You know how to align, motivate, and guide interdisciplinary teams, cultivating a thriving and collaborative environment even as project requirements evolve.

 What you get: 
 Invest in Your Future: Regular feedback and our development program support your growth, helping you expand your skill set and achieve your career goals.

 Easy Arrival to adjoe: From signing to settling in Hamburg, we’ve got you covered. Need a visa? No problem. Ready to build your new life and career at adjoe in Hamburg? We support every ambition—from learning German to a relocation bonus that helps you make Hamburg feel like home.

 Live Your Best Life, at Work and Beyond: We work in a hybrid setup with core office days on Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday, plus flexible working hours. Enjoy 30 vacation days, 3 weeks of remote work per year, and free access to an in-house gym with lots of different fitness classes and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

 Thrive Where You Work: Enjoy the Alster lake view from our central office with top-notch equipment, fun open spaces, and a large variety of snacks and drinks.

 Join the Community! Participate in regular team and company events, including hackathons and social gatherings. We work together, and we celebrate together, too.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
As a Senior Product Manager (m/w/d), you will own eCommerce storefront initiatives end to end, from concept and discovery through launch and optimization, with a global scope across PERGOLUX markets. You will define product solutions, scope, and success metrics for content-rich, UX-heavy customer journeys, and you will drive measurable improvements in storefront performance such as add-to-cart and checkout conversion. Working closely with UX, development, analytics, performance marketing, and country teams, you will structure complex product information into clear, attractive pages that reflect a premium brand experience.
 PERGOLUX designs and sells Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from pergolas to garden furniture, directly to consumers. With around 300 employees, 9-figure revenue, and operations across 8 markets, we have grown consistently across Europe and beyond, building a collaborative international team along the way.
 What You'll Do 
 • Own eCommerce product initiatives from concept to launch and optimization, defining scope, risks, requirements, and success metrics.
 • Conduct product discovery through user research, competitor analysis, usability testing, and synthesizing customer feedback into product decisions.
 • Create page concepts, wireframes, prototypes, copy drafts, and visual briefs, and write clear specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
 • Plan delivery with development, managing priorities, dependencies, QA, releases, rollout logic, toggles, and rollback plans.
 • Monitor launches and use analytics, A/B testing, and experimentation to drive rapid fixes and follow-up improvements to storefront performance.
 What You'll Bring 
 • 5+ years in product management for eCommerce products, with strong experience in UX-heavy, content-rich customer journeys.
 • Proven ability to structure complex product information into clear, simple, and attractive pages, backed by customer research and insight-driven decisions.
 • Strong visual taste and an understanding of what makes a premium digital brand experience, plus the ability to create concepts, wireframes, and copy drafts independently.
 • Solid command of CRO, analytics, A/B testing, and storefront performance optimization, and a track record of aligning UX, developers, analytics, and marketing.
 • Nice to have: experience with Shopify or other storefront platforms, high-ticket or considered-purchase eCommerce, premium/lifestyle brands, and building repeatable product processes or templates.

 💼 Compensation — Competitive salary that reflects your expertise and rewards results · Company pension plan · Capped overtime, fully paid, with no endless unpaid crunch
 🚀 Growth and Career Development — You will take on real ownership from the start with direct impact on key business outcomes, work alongside an international team across Europe, and follow fast-track opportunities to grow into senior leadership roles as PERGOLUX scales.
 ⏰ Time Off and Flexibility — Up to 30 vacation days, starting at 27 · One week per year remote workation in the EU/UK

 🌟 Benefits and Lifestyle 
 • Team culture with regular team events (summer party, Christmas party, after-work gatherings) and retreats
 • Modern setup and laptops (Apple or Windows)
 • Employee discounts on PERGOLUX products
 • Jobrad / bike leasing program, promoting sustainable and healthy commuting
 📍 Office Location – Schlesische Str. 27 C, Building C, 6th floor, 10997 Berlin, Germany
 How to Apply 
 If this role fits what you are looking for, we would like to hear from you. Apply through our [Career Page]( https://pergolux.careers/ ) and connect with us on [LinkedIn]( https://www.linkedin.com/company/pergolux/posts/?feedView=all ) to learn more about life at PERGOLUX.
 PERGOLUX is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, we think it's less about ticking every box and more about what you bring to the table!

At PERGOLUX , we are building a premium outdoor-living brand with ambitious global growth, bringing together international teams through a culture of integrity, ambition, innovation, humility, appreciation, and unity.
 What You’ll Do
 Own the end-to-end execution of assigned new product and product-upgrade launches across Europe, the US, Australia, and other PERGOLUX markets, managing launch plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, responsibilities, and go/no-go decisions.

 Coordinate cross-functionally with Product Development, manufacturing suppliers, Supply Chain, Ecommerce, Content, Marketing, Sales, Customer Service, Compliance, and Country Managers to ensure complete launch readiness across markets and time zones.

 Drive operational readiness by ensuring specifications, installation manuals, certifications, compliance documentation, pricing, SKUs, product content, translations, imagery, Shopify setup, inventory, team training, and support materials are accurate, complete, and approved before launch.

 Define and operate clear quality gates and launch-readiness processes, coordinating manufacturer, field, and laboratory testing, identifying risks early, driving solutions, escalating critical issues, and providing clear launch-status reporting to Product leadership and key stakeholders.

 Continuously improve how we launch products by owning installation manual quality, managing SKU phase-outs and product transitions, conducting post-launch retrospectives, maintaining risk logs and rollout trackers, and reducing avoidable rework and post-launch issues.

 What You’ll Bring
 2–4 years of experience in Product Management, Product Operations, Technical Project Management, or a similar execution-focused role, with experience coordinating product launches, new product introductions, or complex cross-functional projects.

 Strong project planning, timeline management, stakeholder coordination, and structured reporting skills, with the ability to independently manage multiple workstreams and maintain momentum toward critical deadlines.

 Confidence working with physical products, technical specifications, installation manuals, specification sheets, and other product documentation, with strong attention to detail and ownership of quality.

 Experience coordinating directly with overseas or offshore manufacturing suppliers and working effectively across departments, cultures, and time zones; experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Excel, Shopify, Zendesk, or Airtable is a plus.

 A proactive, highly accountable mindset: you identify problems early, ask the right questions, follow actions through to completion, make sound day-to-day decisions independently, and know when commercial, compliance, or strategic decisions require escalation.

 Benefits

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Generative AI Platform
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat. DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt now operate as one global company. Behind the AI experiences millions of people use every day, from shopping assistants to customer support agents, sits one shared Generative AI platform. Our team builds it.

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager in London to own major parts of that platform. Your customers are the engineers and ML researchers across all three brands who build AI products and agents. You'll work with engineering and product leaders in Europe and the US, and your decisions will shape how AI gets built across every market we operate in.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Set the strategy and roadmap for core parts of our GenAI platform: model access and routing, agent infrastructure, and evaluation and observability.
  • Build one platform for three brands. Spot the patterns across Deliveroo, Wolt and DoorDash teams and turn them into shared building blocks, so a capability built once reaches every market.
  • Shape our model portfolio across frontier and open-weight models. Decide where we build, buy or partner in an ecosystem that changes month to month.
  • Make agents production-ready. Give teams safe access to company knowledge, tools and systems, with the quality, latency and cost controls needed to run agents at scale.
  • Own the evaluation strategy so teams can prove quality before launch and keep improving it after.
  • Stay close to your customers. Work with the teams shipping AI experiences, measure adoption and time-to-production, and let real production use drive the roadmap.
  • Lead at a senior level,  presenting to senior technical leadership and influence strategy beyond your own roadmap.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate brings deep expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Significant product management experience (typically 8+ years, or equivalent), including owning a technical platform, developer product, or ML or data infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM-based products or platforms in production, such as assistants, agents, evaluation or inference. GenAI platforms are a young field, so we care more about depth than years.
  • A platform mindset. You notice the problem five teams keep solving and turn it into one capability everyone can use.
  • The ability to go deep with engineers and ML researchers, then explain the trade-off in plain language to a senior leader.
  • A track record of leading large, ambiguous areas on your own and aligning stakeholders across companies, countries and time zones.
  • Comfort with regular overlap with US time zones, including some late-afternoon and evening calls.

What Success Looks Like

A team in any of our three brands can go from idea to a reliable AI product dramatically faster. That happens because the hard parts (models, inference, evaluation, tooling, observability, governance and agent infrastructure) are solved once at the platform layer and get better for everyone.

Why Join Us?

  • Real scale from day one. Your platform powers AI used by millions of consumers, merchants and couriers across three brands.
  • Frontier work, real constraints. You'll work with the latest models and agent patterns, then make them reliable, affordable and compliant in production.
  • Visible impact. Platform decisions here get reviewed by senior leadership and adopted across the company.

 

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
jobs.description:
About BJAK 
 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
 The Role 
 BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
  
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
  
 The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
  
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
  

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
  

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
  

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
  

 Location 
 This is a hybrid role . You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week , with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.
  
 Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round

  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

 Notre client est un opérateur télécom spécialisé dans la connectivité cellulaire pour l’Internet des Objets. Il accompagne de grands comptes industriels à l’international et fournit des solutions technologiques complètes à des opérateurs virtuels.
 Il réunit des experts de l’IT et des télécoms issus de nombreux pays. Les évolutions du secteur (5G, eSIM, virtualisation, cloud) et la croissance de l’IoT ouvrent des postes variés, avec de vraies perspectives d’évolution.
 Le poste
 Vous rejoignez le pôle Produit et l’équipe Product Management, composée de plusieurs Product Managers. Le manager de l’équipe a plus de 20 ans d’expérience produit et marketing dans les télécoms.
 L’activité est portée par de gros contrats à livrer d’ici fin 2026. L’équipe renforce son offre pour en gagner de nouveaux.
 Vous reprenez l’ensemble des sujets de connectivité de l’offre IoT : extension de la couverture cellulaire mondiale et développement de nouvelles connectivités, en particulier le satellite / NTN (Non-Terrestrial Network). Vous travaillez en binôme avec un Product Manager en poste et en lien étroit avec le marketing, la R&I, l’ingénierie, les ventes, l’avant-vente et le support client.
 Vos missions
 Stratégie produit 
 Suivre le marché et les acteurs, formuler des recommandations stratégiques

 Prioriser les développements et arbitrer entre options techniques et partenaires

 Maintenir les composantes de l’offre et contribuer au lancement des évolutions
 Réaliser des analyses d’opportunité (gains business, coûts)
 Marketing et développement commercial 
 Soutenir les équipes vente et avant-vente
 Créer des contenus pour le marketing digital
 Représenter l’entreprise lors d’événements sectoriels et gérer les relations avec partenaires et fournisseurs
 Pilotage et performance 
 Suivre le P&L des sujets traités
 Définir et suivre les indicateurs de performance
 Votre profil
 Diplôme en télécoms ou domaine connexe (Master minimum)

 Très bonnes capacités d’analyse, de résolution de problèmes et de décision
 Aisance en communication et capacité à fédérer des équipes transverses

 Curiosité forte pour la 5G, l’eSIM et le satellite/NTN
 Anglais courant (oral et écrit), usage quotidien
 Ce qui fera votre réussite
 Curiosité, volontarisme et ténacité dans un contexte exigeant, où l’équipe livre déjà de gros projets

 Fixe + bonus individuel

jobs.description:
München (präferiert) oder Remote in Voll- oder Teilzeit

 Baue mit uns die Weiterbildungssuche der Zukunft. 

 Wer heute eine berufliche Weiterbildung sucht, steht vor einer riesigen Auswahl und einer schwierigen Frage: Was passt wirklich zu mir und bringt mich beruflich weiter? Wir sind überzeugt, dass diese Frage digital noch nicht gut genug beantwortet wird. Mit GenauMeinKurs wollen wir das ändern. 

 Wir suchen jemanden mit Drive und dem Anspruch, die beste Weiterbildungssuche zu bauen. Jemanden, der Verantwortung übernehmen will, sich mit unserer gemeinsamen Aufgabe identifiziert und das Produkt mit eigenen Ideen und klarem Fokus voranbringt.

 Mit rund 20 Kolleginnen und Kollegen bieten wir dir viel Gestaltungsspielraum und kurze Entscheidungswege. Unser Gründer- und Führungsteam bringt langjährige Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Skalierung digitaler Plattformen mit – bei uns verbindest du Startup-Geschwindigkeit mit der Möglichkeit, von einem erfahrenen, sympathischen (:)) und outcome-orientierten Team zu lernen.

 Aufgaben

 Du entwickelst GenauMeinKurs zu einem vertrauenswürdigen Begleiter für den nächsten beruflichen Schritt. Du findest heraus, wo Menschen bei der Suche unsicher werden, welche Informationen ihnen fehlen und was ihnen hilft, eine gute Entscheidung zu treffen. Daraus machst du gemeinsam mit unserem Team ein Produkt, das sich einfach anfühlt – auch wenn die Aufgabe dahinter komplex ist.

 Konkret bedeutet das:

 
 Du bist die Stimme der Nutzer im Unternehmen. Du sprichst mit ihnen, wertest Feedback und Nutzungsdaten aus und vertrittst ihre Interessen bei Produktentscheidungen.

 Du gibst der Produktentwicklung Fokus. Du erkennst aus vielen Problemen und Möglichkeiten, was wirklich zählt, setzt klare Prioritäten und entwickelst unsere Produktvision und Roadmap weiter.

 Du suchst die besten Lösungen – auch außerhalb unserer Branche. Du untersuchst, wie führende digitale Produkte Orientierung geben, Entscheidungen erleichtern und komplexe Suchen einfach machen. Relevante Erkenntnisse übersetzt du in eigene Ideen für GenauMeinKurs.

 Du denkst AI first. Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich, um eigene Fragen schneller zu lösen, Ideen zu prüfen und produktiver zu arbeiten. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du mit uns, wie AI Suche, Matching und persönliche Begleitung grundlegend verbessern kann.

 Du bringst Ideen in die Umsetzung. Gemeinsam mit Tech, Growth und weiteren Kolleginnen und Kollegen entwickelst du neue Funktionen und verbesserst die gesamte Nutzerreise.

 Du prüfst den tatsächlichen Nutzen. Du willst wissen, ob Menschen mit GenauMeinKurs eine passendere Weiterbildung finden und eine Entscheidung treffen können, die trägt.

 
 Qualifikation

 Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung digitaler Produkte, zum Beispiel als Product Owner, Product Manager oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle. Wichtiger als ein bestimmter Titel ist uns, wie du denkst und arbeitest.

 Du passt gut zu uns, wenn du:

 Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest und die Energie mitbringst, Dinge voranzutreiben;

 Nutzerprobleme verstehen willst, bevor du Lösungen entwirfst;

 komplexe Dinge einfach erklären und gestalten kannst;

 aus vielen Möglichkeiten das Wesentliche herausfilterst und einem Team Orientierung gibst;

 LLMs sind für Dich fester Bestandteil Deines Arbeitsalltags. Prompts, APIs und Automatisierung findest du spannend – auch wenn Du selbst kein Developer bist;

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Finance
jobs.description:
About BJAK 
 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
 The Role 
 BJAK is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
  
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
  
 The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
  
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
  

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
  

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
  

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
  

 Location 
 This is a hybrid role . You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week , with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.
  
 Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round

  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Group Product Design Manager
jobs.description:
What is Flagstone? 
 Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work.
 Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage.
  
 A feel for our culture: 
 To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.
 That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it.
 We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.
 Does this sound like you? 
 You’re an experienced UX leader who gets the best out of design teams. You’ve led senior designers and managers, raised the bar on design quality, and helped teams spend their time on the right problems.
 What you’ll do 
 Reporting to the Head of UX, You’ll be accountable for the performance of your team, line managing senior individual contributors and player-coaches. You’ll set the direction for design quality, own our Design System, and lead the shift to AI-augmented ways of working. This is a leadership role rather than a squad-based design role, though you’ll roll up your sleeves where it helps the team.
 This will include:
 Leading, coaching, and developing the Product Design team, including objective setting, performance reviews, and making sure managers in your team follow good line management practice

 Embedding AI-augmented ways of working, including AI prototyping, tools, skills, and workflows

 Driving a culture of user-centred design and UI excellence, ensuring what we ship meets real user needs

 Building strong partnerships with Product, Engineering, Research, Brand, and Content, and leading stakeholders up to executive level to follow good UX practice

 Defining metrics that show the impact of design, and building business cases to grow Product Design capability

 What you’ll bring 
 Substantial UX experience, delivering successful work across product areas or programmes, with a strong focus on team leadership, stakeholder influence, and commercial awareness

 Experience line managing senior individual contributors and managers, with accountability for a design team’s performance

 Experience leading Design Ops or design system programmes

 Hands-on experience applying AI tools and workflows in design practice

 Deep experience in one or more channels, such as mobile apps, website design, or web apps

 Strong skills across UX planning and facilitation, user-centred design, interaction design, visual design, and prototyping

 Exceptional facilitation, storytelling, and influencing skills, with the confidence to adapt and find compromise in complex situations

 How we reward you: 
 At Flagstone, the benefits extend beyond false gifts like “fruit and snacks”. Instead, we invest in your health, wealth, and professional development. Here’s a selection of our benefits:
 Hybrid working - Spend at least 1 day a week with your team in our collaborative London office

 Competitive bonus scheme - designed to reward and recognise high performance

 Flexible benefits budget - a pot to fund meaningful benefits for you, whether it's hormone or fertility testing, cancer screening, neuro-diversity coaching or something that matters for you.

 A range of salary sacrifice options to help you make tax efficient savings on electric cars, nursery schemes, home and tech goods.

 Working Abroad - Flagstone employees can work remotely from an approved list of locations for up to 90 days a year

 Mental wellbeing support – Access therapy and mental health sessions through Spill

 Learning and development – £1,000 personal development budget to help you grow in your role.

 Private health care - Enjoy all the benefits AXA has to offer, including reduced gym memberships and medical history disregarded

 Medical cash plan - To help you with the costs of dental and optical expenses

 Life insurance and Income Protection- four times your annual salary for peace of mind

 Matched pension contributions up to 5%

 25 days holiday - plus bank holidays, well-being days and volunteering days

 Enhanced Parental Leave – enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption pay.
  

 All are welcome.

Who You Are

We are seeking a results-driven Senior Product Manager / Product Manager to own key commercial and technical areas of Verve's core programmatic Marketplace. In this role, you will lead cross-functional product execution alongside Engineering, Yield, Commercial, and Operations teams, driving measurable improvements in marketplace performance, publisher yield, and DSP spend.

Depending on your background and expertise, you will take ownership of one of our core exchange areas, including mobile and in-app advertising, SDK integrations, CTV, video, or web.

About Welo Global 

 Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – JetBrains Air (Agentic Development in IDEs)
jobs.description:
Are you comfortable navigating complex software systems, working with coding agents, and defining what makes developer tools actually useful? Do you want to shape how developers and AI work together inside IDEs?

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

Agentic development is changing how software gets built. Developers no longer just chat with AI – they delegate tasks, run parallel agent sessions, and steer autonomous changes. As agents take on more work, reviewing and owning the output is becoming the hardest part of the process. 

JetBrains Air is our open system for agentic development. It brings tools like Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude Agent, Gemini, and Junie directly into JetBrains IDEs, providing an agentic-first user experience.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead key areas of Air. You’ll take ownership of high-impact workflows, work closely with cross-functional teams (including software engineers, designers, ML researchers, analysts, DevRel, and product marketing), and turn technical complexity into clear product direction.

Day to day, you will:

  • Take end-to-end ownership of key parts of Air in JetBrains IDEs, driving work from problem framing and discovery to delivery, adoption, and iteration.
  • Define and refine core agentic workflows, including task delegation, session monitoring, steering, and code review.
  • Model complex user flows, system states, permissions, and integration schemes to guide engineering and design decisions.
  • Maintain a transparent roadmap that balances quick improvements with long-term strategic investments.
  • Define telemetry, design experiments, analyze product data, and make evidence-based roadmap decisions.
  • Study how developers interact with leading AI agents and tools to inform product priorities.
  • Engage with the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) ecosystem and collaborate with partners building on it.
  • Partner with enterprise sales and support teams to address governance, privacy, and control requirements.

What you’ll bring

  • A systems-thinking mindset that easily breaks down complex architectures, workflows, and dependencies.
  • A data-driven approach to product decisions, including hands-on experience querying and analyzing telemetry.
  • Active personal experience using coding agents and clear perspectives on where current AI tools succeed and fail.
  • Strong product intuition for complex technical user experiences and developer workflows.
  • Clear, concise, and collaborative communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts simply and build alignment across diverse groups of stakeholders.
  • Comfort navigating fast-changing technical landscapes with high ambiguity.

What you’ll need

  • Proven experience shipping end-user products as a product manager or in a similar role.
  • Strong technical grounding in software development workflows, including IDEs, git, code review, CI/CD, and package management.
  • A hands-on technical background sufficient to collaborate closely with software and ML engineers.
  • An understanding of core AI and agent concepts, including tool use, protocols (MCP/ACP), context retrieval, evaluations, and latency/cost trade-offs.
  • The ability to write SQL or Python to analyze product metrics and experiment results independently.
  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

What success looks like

In your first 6 to 12 months, success in this role means:

  • Driving measurable growth in active Air users and improving weekly/monthly retention (D7/D30).
  • Increasing agent session completion rates and the proportion of agent-generated changes accepted by developers.
  • Establishing clear, telemetry-backed decisions across your product roadmap areas.
  • Delivering validated product hypotheses consistently each quarter.
  • Contributing directly to JetBrains AI revenue growth and overall IDE value.

Why join JetBrains?

  • Strong base salary – We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Flexible work schedule – Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
  • Extra time off – More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
  • Learning and development opportunities – Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
  • Free meals and sna

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager Transport (Equipment)
jobs.description:
About us 
 Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 100+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!
 
 
 
 Mission of this role 
 Getting equipment to and from an event, on time and in one piece, is one of the most critical things our customers do, and one of the hardest. Heavy, specialised, often fragile gear. Fixed vehicle and crew capacity. Round trips rather than one-way drops. Our customers solve this every week, mostly with spreadsheets, phone calls and hard-won instinct.
 
 Transport is a priority on our roadmap, and we're bringing in dedicated ownership to make sure we deliver on it: how customers plan loads, sequence stops and optimise routes across their fleet. This role owns that outcome from the ground up. You'll start by getting close to customers to find the first slice of the problem they'll genuinely want to have solved, ship it, and build the roadmap from there.
 
 Which features ship is yours to decide. You'll be shaping the domain and its roadmap, with the freedom to define how the product takes form. That's a rare amount of ownership for a PM, building something new from first principles, with real trust in how you get there.
 
 What you'll do 
 Own Transport end to end: Running the full release train for your value stream: discovery, scoping, design, development, launch and post-launch tracking.

 Run customer discovery yourself, in the field: Talk to rental companies about how they plan, staff and execute transport today: warehouse-to-venue routing, multi-stop and multi-vehicle loads, load order, crew and vehicle capacity, and the constraints that make equipment transport harder than generic delivery routing.

 Define the first sellable increment. Find the smallest thing customers will genuinely pay for, ship it, and be able to explain why that slice was the right first bet.

 Build and own a sequenced, evidence-based roadmap with the Head of Product, aligned to company goals and product strategy. And explain the prioritisation to sales, support and management so they can plan against it.

 Translate routing and logistics complexity into buildable scope: multi-stop optimisation, time windows, vehicle and crew capacity, mapping and routing APIs, and the build-vs-buy decisions that come with them.

 Define success before you build it: Every feature carries a business goal, product briefs stay current, a live dashboard goes up at launch, and you drive go-to-market together with Product Marketing, Support, Sales and Content & Community.
 

 
 
 What we are looking for 
 5+ years as a Product Manager in B2B SaaS.

 You've owned a product area end to end. From discovery through launch and post-launch tracking, not a backlog-only PO role.

 You're comfortable with operationally complex problems: routing, scheduling, fleet or capacity planning, supply chain, field service. A logistics background is a plus, not a must.

 You work from data. You can show how you set a success metric, what you did when it was missed, and how you make the business case behind a product call.

Werken bij een van de Top 3 spelers in Workforce management in Nederland en bijdragen aan snelle ontwikkeling in het buitenland? 
Bij Intus helpen wij onze klanten en hun medewerkers met slimmer plannen. Hierdoor dragen we bij aan het oplossen van één van de belangrijkste maatschappelijke uitdagingen: personeelskrapte.

Als project manager bij Intus speel je een cruciale rol in projecten bij onze diverse klanten in verschillende markten zoals zorg, overheid, industrie en logistiek . Je structureert en realiseert meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd van begin tot het eind. Dankzij jouw vermogen om draagvlak te creëren en overzicht te behouden, help je klanten en zorg je voor een efficiënt verloop van de projecten.  
 
Je maakt deel uit van een team van project managers en consultants die verantwoordelijk zijn voor alle projecten in Nederland. About Voodoo
 Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.
 
 Team
 The Engineering & Data team builds innovative tech products and platforms to support the impressive growth of their gaming and consumer apps which allow Voodoo to stay at the forefront of the mobile gaming industry.
 Helix is our flagship Ad-Network team of around 60 top-tier engineers and data scientists spanning backend, mobile SDKs, data engineering, infrastructure, and AI. Helix has evolved beyond powering Voodoo's own gaming portfolio—our technology is now directly integrated into games from external, third-party publishers worldwide.
 Operating across millions of third-party devices in real-time bidding environments creates unique technical challenges around SDK performance, ultra-low latency, and intelligent automation.
 Within Helix, you'll join the RTB team, the group that owns the bidder and the services behind it that help it take the optimal bidding decision. Bidder, pricing, models and data are all built in-house, so nothing is out of reach when you want to change how a bid gets made. You will work with expert backend and machine-learning engineers in real-time bidding, on a system that prices ad requests across mobile gaming in real time, at a scale few teams get to work at.
 
 Role
 We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager - Real Time Bidding to join our Engineering & Data team. In this role, you’ll drive product decisions across the full bidding pipeline.
 You'll own projects end-to-end: roadmap, trade-offs, shipping, and cross-team contract. You will also:
 Own the roadmap of the bidding pipeline. How we target, price, pace and cap, and what goes live in the bid path and when.

 Own the delivery. Adapt to changes, set clear priorities, communicate effectively

 Own experimentation as a product. Other teams test ideas on the bidder through the framework we build. You make sure they can run the experiments they need, trust the results, and get an answer fast.

 Keep the pieces fitting together. You spot a change in one team that will break another before it reaches production.

 Contribute to the product strategy beyond your scope.

 
 Profile (Must have)
 Experience in programmatic advertising. You have worked on pricing, bidding or auction logic on a DSP, bidder or exchange, you know the pipeline from bid request to win, and you can explain the business impact of your work.

 Analytical mindset. You back decisions with data and understand the statistical basis of pricing and experimentation.

 You own outcomes across teams. When a change in one team is about to break another, you catch it and drive the fix before it ships.

 You use AI tooling daily to write specs, analyse data and prototype, and you move faster because of it.

 
 Profile (Nice to have)
 Mobile user acquisition: app install campaigns, attribution or mediation.

 Experience working with ML or data science teams.

 Supply-side experience: ad exchange or SSP.

 Background in statistics, operations research or economics.

 
 Benefits
 Competitive salary based on experience

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Enterprise Deployment Solutions |  Germany | Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Germany.

About Product Management

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own the experience for your product as well as its roadmap and competitive positioning, and you will collaborate with company leadership on setting your product's goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connects R&D to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

The role

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you'll own the Grafana Labs offerings that run outside our standard multi-tenant SaaS. That includes Grafana Federal Cloud, for organizations that need FedRAMP-authorized observability: US federal agencies; state, local, and education (SLED) customers; and commercial companies that sell FedRAMP offerings of their own. It also includes Grafana Cloud Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC), which delivers the full Grafana Cloud experience while the customer pays the infrastructure bill directly to their cloud provider, saving them significantly at scale.

Your mission is to make Grafana Labs the obvious choice for organizations that can't use standard SaaS because of compliance, data, or cost-at-scale constraints. Deployment choices change the product: features that are simple in standard SaaS can be hard, expensive, or impossible in a regulated or customer-owned environment. You’ll be responsible for adapting existing Grafana Cloud capabilities to these environments, deciding which features come in, which wait, and which stay out, and occasionally building something specific to BYOC or Federal Cloud. You'll also help shape which deployment models we offer next.

Along the way, you’ll use AI tools daily to speed up research, analyze product signals, and develop positioning, applying strong judgment to the results.

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you will: 

  • Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Grafana Bring Your Own Cloud and Grafana Federal Cloud products, using product data and market research to balance customer value against engineering cost and technical constraints
  • Own positioning, messaging, and differentiation for these products, including how they compare to regular Grafana Cloud, and partner with Product Marketing on launches, competitive analysis, enablement, and demand programs
  • Partner with Engineering and Technical Program Management on buildouts for these environments, balancing customer timelines with engineering capacity
  • Work directly with customers, prospects, and the field on strategic deals and brief partners, resellers, and analysts on our deployment options

 🎯 Ton terrain de jeu
