 🤝 Faire entendre ta voix : conseiller les parties prenantes, challenger les demandes et embarquer les équipes autour des bonnes décisions produit.

 Ton rôle ne sera pas simplement de coordonner : tu seras là pour apporter une véritable expertise Product et créer de la valeur.
 
 ✨ Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ?

 Parce que rejoindre Hubvisory, c'est intégrer un cabinet qui place le Product Management au cœur de son expertise, tout en cultivant l'apprentissage, l'ambition et l'esprit d'équipe.

 Ce qui t'attend : 
 📈 Une carrière qui évolue : des revalorisations salariales biannuelles et des perspectives vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil.

 🧠 Une communauté d'experts : un environnement où partager, apprendre et progresser fait partie du quotidien.

 💰 Un package attractif : rémunération fixe, variable, intéressement et congés payés supplémentaires.

 💜 Des engagements concrets : signataire du Parental Challenge, Hubvisory propose notamment un arrêt fausse couche rémunéré à 100 % et le maintien de salaire à 100 % pendant les congés maternité et second parent.

 🌍 Une entreprise engagée : plus de 20 projets à impact menés depuis 2022, avec la participation volontaire de 20 % des collaborateurs (mécénat de compétences, maraudes, Fresque du Climat…).

 Depuis 10 ans, Hubvisory grandit autour de cinq valeurs : expertise, apprentissage, ambition, bienveillance et méritocratie. 
 Envie de donner une nouvelle dimension à ta carrière Product ? On a hâte d'échanger avec toi ! 🚀 
 
 
 🔍 Le profil qu'on recherche

 Tu as 3 à 6 ans d'expérience en Product Management sur des produits digitaux et tu as déjà eu l'occasion de piloter des sujets de bout en bout.
 Tu maîtrises les fondamentaux du métier, mais surtout, tu sais les mettre en pratique dans des environnements exigeants.

 Côté Product, tu sais : 
 Mener une Discovery structurée et transformer les besoins utilisateurs en opportunités concrètes.

 Construire une roadmap, prioriser un backlog et piloter le delivery en environnement agile.

 Collaborer efficacement avec les équipes Tech, Design et Business.

 Définir et suivre des KPI pour mesurer l'impact de tes décisions.

 Prendre du recul, challenger les demandes et arbitrer en fonction de la valeur business.

 Côté posture, tu fais la différence par : 
 🤝 Ton aisance relationnelle et ta capacité à communiquer avec des interlocuteurs variés.

 💡 Ton autonomie, ton esprit d'initiative et ta capacité à proposer des solutions.

 🎯 Ton sens de l'analyse, ta rigueur et ton orientation résultats.

 🚀 Ta curiosité et ton envie de progresser dans des contextes clients variés.

 Ce qu'on apprécie particulièrement ? Les Product Managers capables d'allier vision stratégique, sens du concret et intelligence collective.

 💰 Rémunération
 46 à 58 K€ brut annuel fixe + variable + intéressement.

 Un processus transparent pour apprendre à se connaître et te permettre de te projeter :
 Échange avec Caroline, Talent Partner : ton parcours, tes motivations et tes attentes.

 Cas pratique Product en live avec un Manager (90 min) : pour découvrir ta manière de réfléchir et de résoudre des problématiques produit.

 Entretien avec un VP ou cofondateur (90 min) : pour échanger sur ta vision et tes ambitions.

 Closing et proposition d'embauche .

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
Functieomschrijving 
 Als Product Owner Interne Automatisering & IT ben jij de onmisbare brug tussen de business en ons IT-landschap. Je haalt de wensen en requirements op bij verschillende afdelingen en het Management Team, en vertaalt deze naar slimme, efficiënte automatiseringen. Waar anderen een complex proces zien, zie jij een kans om zaken sneller, beter en soepeler te laten verlopen. 
 In deze rol schakel je veel met interne stakeholders om processen echt te doorgronden. Vervolgens bepaal je hoe we onze tools, waaronder ons ERP-systeem Odoo en Camunda, optimaal kunnen inzetten. Je werkt hierbij nauw samen met onze Applicatiebeheerder, die het functionele beheer voor zijn rekening neemt en onze Camunda/Python Developer. Omdat onze developer ook eigen projecten draait, is het fantastisch als jij zelf de taal van developers spreekt of zelfs je eigen Python-code kunt kloppen om snel iets te bouwen of testen. 
 
 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden 
 Ophalen, analyseren en in kaart brengen van requirements bij diverse afdelingen en de MT-laag. 

 Vertalen van bedrijfsprocessen en wensen naar concrete automatiseringsoplossingen. 

 Beheren, prioriteren en structureren van de interne IT-backlog. 

 Samenwerken met de interne Camunda/Python developer en de Applicatiebeheerder om projecten succesvol en vlot op te leveren. 

 Adviseren van de business over procesoptimalisaties en nieuwe automatiseringskansen. 

 Zorgdragen voor een soepele implementatie en adoptie van nieuwe functionaliteiten op de werkvloer. 

 
 Over Payter 
 Bij Payter zijn we pioniers op het gebied van contactloze NFC- en cashless-technologie. Sinds 2007 maken we impact: we hebben het grootste Europese proefproject voor contactloze en mobiele betalingen gelanceerd, en sindsdien maken bedrijven over de hele wereld gebruik van onze oplossingen. We combineren innovatieve technologieën om veilige, duurzame en toekomstbestendige producten te ontwikkelen. Bij Payter krijg je de kans om bij te dragen aan slimme oplossingen die écht verschil maken in een snel veranderende wereld. 
 
 Je hebt hbo-werk- en -denkniveau en een sterke interesse in IT en bedrijfsprocessen. 

 Je bent communicatief vaardig, stapt makkelijk op mensen af en kunt goed schakelen met zowel de business als technische collega's. 

 Je snapt hoe bedrijfsprocessen lopen en wordt oprecht enthousiast van het automatiseren hiervan. 

 Je hebt (basis)kennis van Python; het is een hele mooie bonus als je zelf ook af en toe wat code kunt schrijven. 

 Je hebt bij voorkeur kennis van of interesse in ERP-systemen (zoals Odoo) 

 Je bent analytisch, nieuwsgierig en pakt graag de regie om projecten van wens tot realiteit te brengen. 

 Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. 

 
 Wat Wij Bieden 
 Ruimte voor professionele ontwikkeling met trainingen en andere ontwikkelmogelijkheden 

 25 vakantiedagen 

 12 balancedays voor een goede werk-privébalans 

 Gratis lunch op het kantoor 

 Werken in een dynamische en energieke omgeving 

 Meegroeien met Payter en echt impact maken 

 Goed bereikbaar kantoor

jobs.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace. 
 

 Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence. 
 

 Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.

jobs.title: Group Product Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are 
 You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.
 We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.
 Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.
 Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.
 Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.
 The Problem You'll Solve 
 Prosus is building an AI-first future across a global portfolio that spans food delivery, e-commerce, fintech, and education. We invest over $100 million annually in AI, run 800+ models in production, and have deployed Toqan — our internal platform for building, testing, and deploying GenAI and agentic workflows — across the organisation. The scale of ambition is real; the challenge now is focus, coherence, and velocity.
 As Group Product Manager for our AI Platform, you will own the multi-year product strategy for the platform that underpins every AI initiative across Prosus. This means defining and sequencing the roadmap for agent infrastructure, evaluation frameworks, model deployment pipelines, and the shared capabilities that internal teams — from applied science to application engineering — rely on to build and ship AI products. You will balance long-term platform investments against the immediate, high-impact needs of teams across the portfolio who are racing to deliver.
 You will lead and mentor a team of product managers, instilling product discipline and building the PM talent pipeline that scales with the platform. You will partner closely with engineering and applied science leadership to shape the technical strategy — making the hard trade-offs between model performance, latency, cost, and reliability that determine what we can promise the business.
 And you will be the connective tissue: the person who turns ambiguous, fast-moving business needs into clear requirements, who aligns stakeholders across functions and geographies, and who ensures that what we build is not just technically impressive but adopted, trusted, and measurably impactful.
 
 Who You Are 
 You are a senior product leader who has lived through the messy reality of building platform products for internal teams — and loved it. You measure your success not by features shipped but by the velocity and quality of the teams who build on top of your platform.
 
 You are deeply technical. You can engage substantively with engineering and applied science teams on model lifecycle, MLOps, evaluation frameworks, and infrastructure trade-offs — not as a bystander, but as a thought partner. You understand agentic architectures, LLM capabilities and limitations, and the operational realities of running AI in production at scale.
 
 You are a people leader. You have managed and mentored product managers, and you take genuine pride in their growth. You set strategic direction, coordinate overlapping roadmaps into a coherent plan, and create the clarity that lets your team operate with autonomy and purpose.
 
 You thrive in ambiguity. You have worked in fast-paced, high-scale environments where priorities shift and the path forward is not always clear. You do not wait for perfect information — you run rapid experiments, test hypotheses, and let data and user feedback guide the next step.
 
 You are a communicator. You can simplify complex technical concepts for executive leadership one hour and dig into detailed requirements with an engineering team the next. You build trust across functions and geographies, and you are as comfortable pushing back as you are building consensus.
 
 You are customer-obsessed — even when your customers are internal teams. You connect frequently with the people who use your platform, validate solutions through product discovery, and treat adoption as a first-class metric.
 
 What You Bring 
 8+ years in product management, with at least 3–5 years in formal people-management roles leading a team of product managers.

 Demonstrated success owning platform-level or infrastructure products used by internal teams — ideally including AI/ML platform capabilities, MLOps tooling, or developer-facing services.

jobs.title: Project Manager (mid)
jobs.description:
Project Manager
 Location: Alkmaar, Netherlands
 Working Arrangement: 5 Days Onsite, Alkmaar Office
 
 Join Our Team as a Project Manager at Beyond Sports
 If you’re someone who thrives on bringing people, technology, and clients together, enjoys taking ownership of projects from start to finish, and gets energy from delivering high-quality digital products, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.
 At Beyond Sports, you’ll work on innovative consumer-facing products and experiences within the sports world, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to turn ideas and client requirements into successful deliveries.
 
 What Your Day Will Look Like
 As a Project Manager within the Beyond Sports Delivery Team, you’ll be responsible for the end-to-end delivery of consumer-facing software projects, including websites, mobile applications, data visualizations, and other digital sports experiences.
 You’ll take ownership of scoping, planning, budgeting, and project delivery, while making sure projects stay on track and meet the quality our clients and users expect. You’ll work closely with our Design, Engineering, and QA teams, facilitating collaboration and ensuring everyone has the clarity they need to deliver successfully.
 You’ll also be a key point of contact for our external clients. From translating customer requirements and feedback into clear scopes, functional requirements, and user stories to managing expectations, risks, and project progress, you’ll make sure communication stays clear throughout the entire project lifecycle.
 When our products go live, you’ll be there too, acting as a central point of communication and helping coordinate and escalate where necessary during live events.
 
 What We Value
 At Beyond Sports, we value people who take ownership, communicate clearly, and are comfortable working in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.
 As a Project Manager, you’ll need to be proactive and organised, while also being able to adapt your approach depending on the project, client, and team you’re working with. You should be comfortable managing several projects at once and confident bringing together different perspectives to keep everyone moving towards the same goal.
 We’re looking for someone who understands the world of technology and software development and can comfortably translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience working with data-driven products or projects is particularly valuable for this role.
 While this role is based in Alkmaar, Netherlands, we believe in the power of in-person collaboration, so we expect you to be available for 32–40 hours per week in the office .
 
 Skills and Experience
 You don’t need to tick every box, but here’s what we’re looking for:
 Proven experience managing software or digital projects from start to finish, ideally including consumer-facing products such as websites, mobile applications, or data visualization products

 Experience with project scoping, planning, budgeting, and resource coordination

 Strong understanding of software development processes and working with multidisciplinary teams across Design, Engineering, and QA

 Experience translating customer requirements and feedback into clear scopes, functional requirements, and user stories

 Strong client and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to act as the main point of contact throughout project delivery

 Excellent communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

 Experience managing project risks, issues, reporting, documentation, and delivery progress

 The ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and attention to detail

 A proactive and solution-oriented approach to problem-solving

 Strong collaboration and facilitation skills, with the ability to bring teams and stakeholders together around decisions

 The confidence to negotiate, manage expectations, and resolve conflicts professionally when needed

jobs.title: Director of Product Management and IT Operations
jobs.description:
About Self Bill Pro: 
 Self Bill Pro is a rapidly growing startup dedicated to solving one of the most persistent challenges in the employee benefits ecosystem: the complexity of monthly benefits billing. We provide a tech-enabled service where our dedicated team leverages proprietary software to eliminate the administrative burdens of manual invoice audits and costly billing errors. Our mission is to streamline this critical operation, freeing up employers, brokers, and carriers to focus on their strategic priorities. 
 
 About the Role: Compensation - $130,000 - 160,000
 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Director of Product Management and IT Operations to lead the strategic direction and operational execution of our proprietary software platform. This is a critical leadership role that requires a unique blend of product management expertise, technical acumen, and operational leadership. You will be responsible for defining and driving the product roadmap while also ensuring the stability and security of our IT infrastructure and systems. 
 Reports to: Chief Operating Officer 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Product Leadership: Partner with our global product manager to define, prioritize, and manage the product roadmap, ensuring it aligns with overall business objectives and our long-term technology vision. 

 Product Development: Lead the product development lifecycle from ideation to launch, including gathering and analyzing user feedback, writing detailed user stories and specifications, and collaborating with our offshore software development team. 

 Technical Oversight: Provide technical oversight and guidance to the development team on product features, enhancements, and operational issues. 

 Compliance & Security: Ensure compliance with security standards (e.g., SOC 2, HIPAA) and best practices, working to protect the organizationâs data and systems. 

 Stakeholder Management: Effectively communicate with and manage relationships with various stakeholders, including customers, investors, and internal teams to gather requirements, test ideas, and communicate product progress. 

 Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with the stateside operational team to field feedback and translate business needs into technical requirements. 

 IT Operations & Helpdesk: Oversee day-to-day IT operations, including helpdesk support and quick resolution of operational issues and hotfixes as new employees are onboarded. 

 
 Extensive experience in a product management role, with a strong background in software development and project management. 

 Direct experience in the employee benefits or benefits administration technology space is a must. 

 Proven ability to think creatively about building software solutions and features that solve complex, real-world problems. 

 Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

 Experience managing and collaborating with a global or offshore development team. 

 Practical knowledge of IT operations, helpdesk support, and cybersecurity principles. 

 Familiarity with SOC 2 and HIPAA compliance requirements is highly desirable. 

 A natural leader with the ability to inspire and motivate a team, foster a positive work environment, and manage a high-volume workload in a fast-paced environment. 

 Why Join Us? At Self Bill Pro, youâll join a collaborative and ambitious team dedicated to transforming outdated processes through smart, scalable technology. As a key leader in a rapidly growing organization, you will have a direct impact on our product, our clients, and our future. If you are a highly motivated individual with a passion for technology, data, and making a tangible difference in the employee benefits landscape, we encourage you to apply! 
 Equal Opportunity Self Bill Pro is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Sovereign & Hybrid Deployments
jobs.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:  

Planet is expanding its platform capabilities to support customers who require dedicated, in-region, or on-premises instantiations of our core platform. As the Senior Product Manager for Sovereign & Hybrid Deployments, you will drive the productization of our platform for isolated, air-gapped, and hybrid environments.

You will serve as the critical bridge between high-touch enterprise customer delivery and scalable core engineering. In this role, you will balance deep customer empathy with product discipline—translating complex operational requirements into repeatable core platform capabilities while establishing clear extension points for Professional Services.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin, Haarlem or Ljubljana office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Conduct deep-dive discovery with high-security enterprise and government stakeholders to understand their operational realities, using those insights to set clear, defensible product priorities.
  • Define and structure the explicit, phased customer journey framework—establishing the operational models, readiness criteria, and governance standards for initial platform installation, joint-operations training, and the final transition into fully autonomous, customer-operated environments with zero or limited vendor access.
  • Translate customer operational and security requirements into clear technical specifications for Core Infrastructure and Engineering teams with detail-oriented accuracy. Synthesizes underlying commonalities across clients who describe similar operational needs using different language, preventing costly, redundant engineering effort.
  • Define standardized building blocks that allow the core platform to extend safely into varying edge and air-gapped environments without hardcoding custom variants for every deployment.
  • Define clear boundaries for what belongs in the core platform versus what can be customized. Design clear hooks and interfaces so Professional Services and integration partners can build custom extensions without modifying core platform code.

What You Bring:

  • 6+ years of relevant work experience in Technical Product Management focusing on enterprise platforms, hybrid cloud deployments, or complex infrastructure products.
  • Ability to sit down with enterprise or government clients, listen to complex operational workflows, and identify the root problem behind divergent customer terminology.
  • Track record productizing cloud-native software platforms to deploy into customer-managed infrastructure, enterprise VPCs, or air-gapped data centers.
  • Ability to apply conceptual understanding of enterprise hybrid patterns similar to AWS Outposts, Azure Stack, Kubernetes-based enterprise distribution platforms (e.g., Red Hat OpenShift), or infrastructure automation frameworks (e.g., HashiCorp Terraform/Vault).
  • Experience setting clear boundaries between core platform roadmap items and custom extensions delivered by Professional Services.
  • Detail-oriented mindset capable of mapping out complex operational transitions, training milestones, and access handoffs.

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Prior experience navigating European sovereign cloud frameworks, regional data residency mandates, or EU defense/government compliance standards.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Search & Ranking
jobs.description:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

  • Taking ownership and driving impact 
  • Being open to change and feedback
  • Being passionate about our mission and our customers. 

Your mission

Every Product Manager at Catawiki owns a meaningful part of the customer experience.

In Search and Ranking, your mission is to help buyers find the special objects they care about. You will shape how search, ranking and personalisation work across the buyer journey, making discovery more relevant and helping more buyers find objects they love.

This is a broad product area. It brings together buyer needs, expert curation, marketplace priorities, search experiences and machine learning. You will identify the most important opportunities, set a clear direction and lead a cross functional team from insight to measurable customer and business impact.

The solution is not prescribed. You may improve search relevance, ranking, recommendations or personalisation, or explore new AI enabled ways to help buyers discover objects. What matters is that you solve a meaningful customer problem, measure the impact and scale what works.

You will own the strategy, outcomes and execution for this area, working closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing and Commercial teams.

What you will do

  1. Set and communicate a clear product vision, strategy and roadmap for Search and Ranking.
  2. Own measurable outcomes across search relevance, discovery, engagement and buyer conversion.
  3. Use behavioural data, customer research and commercial insight to identify and prioritise the biggest opportunities.
  4. Turn ambiguous customer and business problems into clear hypotheses, prototypes and executable plans.
  5. Lead initiatives from early discovery through experimentation, launch and scaling.
  6. Define success metrics and build a rigorous experimentation agenda for search, ranking and personalisation.
  7. Work with machine learning engineers and data scientists to assess model quality, test new approaches and improve customer outcomes.
  8. Improve the relevance of search results and recommendations across the buyer journey.
  9. Integrate personalisation into the customer experience in ways that feel useful, coherent and trustworthy.
  10. Design, run and evaluate experiments, using positive, negative and inconclusive results to guide decisions.
  11. Use AI and rapid prototyping to test ideas early, reduce development risk and accelerate learning.
  12. Create clarity, momentum and accountability across teams, including when priorities or incentives differ.
  13. Communicate strategy, performance, tradeoffs and recommendations clearly to senior and C level stakeholders.

Who you are

Three qualities matter most in this role.

Outcome ownership

You take responsibility for customer and business results, not only for delivering features. You stay with the problem, remove obstacles and change direction when the evidence calls for it.

Systems thinking

You understand how search, ranking, recommendations, auction dynamics, expert curation and marketplace health influence one another. You make thoughtful decisions across the full buyer journey.

Experimental rigour

You use data, research, prototypes and controlled experiments to make decisions. You learn from negative results and can distinguish meaningful progress from activity.

You will also bring:

  1. At least five years of product management experience, preferably in consumer ecommerce, marketplaces or another digital product at scale.
  2. Experience owning a broad product area or customer journey, rather than only individual features.

jobs.description:
OUR MISSION 
 We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond.
 Today, Thyme Care is a market-leading value-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country. If you're inspired to make cancer care more human and to help reimagine what's possible, we'd love to meet you. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters.

You will establish the product foundation across workflow tooling, data integrations, and AI systems, while creating patterns that can scale across future products and initiatives. Much of this work sits at the intersection of applied AI, clinical guidelines, and operational workflows in a regulated setting where fidelity, auditability, and trust are non-negotiable. This is an individual contributor role today, with the opportunity to build and lead a product team over time as this business line grows.
 Additionally, you will:
 Drive the roadmap for a zero-to-one AI initiative to improve care decisions in oncology

 Partner with engineering to shape the technical architecture around AI systems, data models, and integrations

 Leverage AI to accelerate your own work and help decide how the team uses AI tooling to move faster and prototype more efficiently

 Experience in oncology, serious illness / palliative care, or chronic condition management

jobs.title: Product Design Lead
jobs.description:
Fuel50 is a workforce transformation platform helping organisations understand workforce capability, build skills and enable internal mobility in an AI-driven world. Our products combine skills intelligence, talent marketplace experiences and responsible AI to help people and organisations take their next step.Â 
 We are looking for a Product Design Lead to shape the next chapter of our product experience and design organisation.Â 
 This is a senior player-coach role. You will lead and develop our product design team while staying close to the work, setting direction, shaping product strategy, prototyping ideas and helping teams ship high-quality experiences.Â 
 You will work closely with Product and Engineering as a leadership trio, influencing decisions across the organisation and helping Fuel50 build products that are simple, trusted and valuable.Â 
 If youâre a strategic design leader who still loves getting close to the work, developing people and shipping real product, weâd love to hear from you!Â 
What you'll do: Lead, manage and coach our product designers, supporting their growth and helping them reach their next level.Â 
 Set and communicate a clear product design vision across Fuel50's skills intelligence, talent mobility and AI-powered experiences, and tell the story of where our products are going in a way that excites customers, colleagues and leadership.Â 
 Own the design direction without waiting for it to be handed to you. Spot opportunities, form a point of view, and prototype ideas to make them tangible.Â 
 Bring a strong point of view to senior conversations, challenge assumptions constructively and influence decisions across the business.Â 
 Partner with Product and Engineering from discovery through to delivery, balancing customer value, design quality, technical reality and pace.Â 
 Design human-centred AI experiences with appropriate trust, explainability, user control and clear handoffs, including agent and assistant experiences that work across multiple surfaces such as the Fuel50 platform, Microsoft Teams and Copilot.Â 
 Grow our design engineering capability, and be comfortable building and shipping working prototypes or code yourself.Â 
 Evolve our design system, accessibility standards (including WCAG compliance) and design-to-code practices so Fuel50 feels coherent and high quality across every product.Â 
 Shape design team structure, capability, hiring, planning and ways of working as the organisation evolves.Â 
 
What you'll bring: Experience in product design in a SaaS or technology environment (we suggest 7 or more years), including at least 2 years leading, managing or coaching designers, and a track record of building healthy, high-performing teams.Â 
 Strong product design craft across discovery, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, research and shipped digital products.Â 
 Experience designing complex, connected systems and journeys for multiple personas, ideally in an enterprise or B2B product.Â 
 The ability to think big and set a compelling vision, while staying pragmatic about what can be learned and shipped next.Â 
 The ability to originate ideas and direction, and to communicate them clearly through stories, prototypes and design narrative.Â 
 Confidence working with experienced senior stakeholders and influencing through clarity, judgement and strong communication.Â 
 Experience working closely with Product and Engineering as a genuine cross-functional trio.Â 
 Technical fluency and a willingness to get into the code. You should be comfortable building working prototypes using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or similar tools, and have contributed code that has shipped to production, for example front-end changes or design system components submitted through pull requests.Â 
 Hands-on experience using AI coding and design tools, such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, to prototype faster and ship real work. We want someone who uses these tools well and can show how they have changed the way their team works.Â 
 Working knowledge of accessibility and WCAG. You have designed to WCAG standards, tested for it, and built accessibility into your team's design system and review process.Â 
 An interest in design systems and data-informed decision-making.Â 
 You do not need to tick every box. We care about the quality of your thinking, the way you work with people and your ability to turn ambitious ideas into better product experiences.Â 

 All Fuellies are a core part of our culture and making Fuel50 an amazing place to work. Some additional benefits are:Â Â 
 A day off on your birthday and your Fuel50 anniversaryÂ 
 A âReFuel Dayâ once a quarter to relax and refuelÂ 
 Remote work and flexible work times - we're supportive of school commitments, traveling in off-peak hours, and attending to lifeâs eventsÂ 
 A progressive parental leave policyÂ 
 Comprehensive fully subsidised health insurance with Southern CrossÂ

jobs.title: Product Manager - Device Data Management (Fluent French & English)
jobs.description:
Job title: Product Manager - Device Data Management (Fluent French & English) 

Location: Paris — Hybrid (3 days in office)

Salary: €57,600 - €72,000

Team: Product Management - Data Device Management 

Reporting to: Group Product Manager

This role is based in Paris, France and requires the successful candidate to be based in or willing to relocate to Paris. Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential for this position. 

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship

Please submit your profile in English. 

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners. 

By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

You'll lead the French localisation of Device Data Management — one of the core product areas within the Kaluza platform that brings together data on supplies, meters, registers, reads and consumption. This area also covers the journeys around managing this data (like updating a meter's configuration), the APIs that expose it, the frontend pages that surface it to users, and the calculations behind consumption projection and forecasting. This is a hands-on, full-stack product role — you'll work across the whole product area, from the data model through to what users see on screen.

  • Translate French market requirements into clear specifications — turn the rules of the French energy market (including how device and meter data flows between grid operators and suppliers) into detailed product requirements covering compliance, data flows and data quality.
  • Build close working relationships — work hand in hand with key partners in the French market to understand their needs, shape requirements together, and build the kind of trusted relationship where they come to you first, using that closeness to steer what we build next for France.
  • Build, don't just specify. Go from idea to working prototype yourself — query data, sketch API contracts, and stand up proofs of concept. We expect you to use AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code) as a daily multiplier to prototype, investigate, and unblock, not just to draft documents.
  • Align global and local teams across all functions — partner closely with engineering, UX, QA and more, with full-stack influence, keeping everyone pointed at the right outcomes. Be the go-to person for this product area in France, and act as the link between our global and local teams to inform priorities and strategy.

About You

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager, Business Analyst, or equivalent role in software companies, with a strong track record of successfully localising complex software products for international markets
  • Previous experience in the French energy industry — you know how the market works and its key players (e.g. Enedis / GRDF), especially around device data and market flows. Experience with energy management or utility platforms in the French market is a strong plus.
  • Fluent in French and very comfortable in English — our platform and many of our teams operate in English, so you move easily between both.
  • Confident working directly with clients — you can run a working session with client stakeholders, draw out the real requirement behind the ask, and keep senior people aligned and brought

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Stellenbezeichnung – Senior Technical Project Manager 
 Unternehmen – iwell – Your Partner for Sustainable Energy Solutions 
 Standort – Homeoffice-basiert, mit regelmäßigen Besuchen im Düsseldorfer Büro
 
 
 Über iwell 
 Bei iwell dreht sich alles um die Stärkung der Energiesicherheit. Wir helfen europäischen Unternehmen, unabhängiger in ihrer Energieversorgung zu werden. Denn angesichts wachsender regulatorischer Anforderungen, extremer Preisschwankungen und zunehmender Netzprobleme müssen sie einfach widerstandsfähiger werden. Es ist also Zeit, die Initiative zu ergreifen und vorausschauend zu denken.
 
 
 Wir bieten Energiemanagementsysteme, die sicherstellen, dass Unternehmen jederzeit die Kontrolle über ihre Energie behalten. Unser intern entwickeltes EMS und modularer Batteriespeicher steigern durch Nachhaltigkeit die Rentabilität und machen Unternehmen zukunftssicher. Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes, internationales Team aus mutigen, talentierten Menschen. Von Ingenieuren und Softwareentwicklern bis hin zu kreativen Köpfen und kundenorientierten Business Developern – wir suchen Menschen, die entschlossen sind, einen positiven Beitrag zu leisten.
 
 
 Als Pionier: in im deutschen Markt trägst Du direkt zur Energiewende in Deutschland bei und arbeitest eng mit dem Head of Projects und seinem Team in den Niederlanden zusammen.
 
 
 Die Rolle 
 Als Senior Technical Project Manager übernimmst Du die technische und operative Verantwortung für unsere komplexesten Kundenprojekte im deutschen Markt – von der frühen Anbahnung über die Vertragsunterzeichnung bis zur erfolgreichen Inbetriebnahme. 
 Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Installateuren, Lieferanten und unseren internen Teams in den Niederlanden. 
 Dein Beitrag sorgt dafür, dass anspruchsvolle Batterieprojekte termingerecht, budgetgerecht und in hoher Qualität realisiert werden. 

 
 Technisches Projektmanagement & Kundenbetreuung 
 Leitung neuer und komplexer Kundenprojekte in Deutschland, von der Anbahnung bis zur Übergabe 

 Frühzeitige Einbindung in neue Projekte, um technische Fragestellungen von Kunden und Partnern zu klären 

 Anwendung eines risikobasierten Ansatzes: Übersetzung kundenspezifischer Anforderungen in strukturierte technische Vorgaben 

 Eskalation von Produktlücken oder systemischen Problemen an die richtigen internen Stellen 

 Steuerung eines komplexen externen Stakeholderfelds – Kunden, Installateure, Auftragnehmer, Lieferanten 

 Projektkoordination & Umsetzung 
 Koordination aller relevanten internen und externen Stakeholder nach Vertragsabschluss 

 Zeitplanung, Bestellvorgänge, Installationsabläufe und Reporting durchgehend im Blick behalten 

 Sicherstellen, dass Projekte hohe Qualitätsstandards und Deadlines einhalten 

 Enge Begleitung von Installation und Inbetriebnahme, inklusive Validierung der Systemleistung 

 Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit 
 Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product Management, Engineering, Field Operations und Customer Operations 

 Weitergabe von Felderfahrungen aus dem deutschen Markt an das Produktteam in den Niederlanden 

 Als erfahrene Ansprechperson im Technical Project Management Team fungieren und jüngere Kolleg:innen unterstützen 

 Marktaufbau Deutschland 
 Aktive Mitgestaltung des Aufbaus des deutschen Teams und der lokalen Arbeitsweisen 

 Einbringen neuer Perspektiven, um Prozesse zu verbessern und den deutschen Markt zu skalieren
 
 

 Was wir suchen 
 Fachlich 
 Studium im Elektroingenieurwesen mit Schwerpunkt Energie oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation 

 Mehrjährige (idealerweise 5+ Jahre) Erfahrung im Management komplexer (elektro-)technischer Installationsprojekte 

 Erfahrung im Bereich Batteriesysteme, Energiespeicher oder erneuerbare Energien von Vorteil 

 Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch 

 Persönlich 
 Du denkst proaktiv und behältst auch bei komplexen Projekten den Überblick 

 Du arbeitest strukturiert, pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert 

 Du übernimmst Verantwortung für ein vielfältiges Stakeholderfeld und triffst Entscheidungen 

 Du fühlst dich wohl in einem dynamischen, grenzüberschreitenden Arbeitsumfeld 

 Standort & Mobilität 
 Wohnsitz in Deutschland; Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands sowie zu Branchenmessen und Networking-Veranstaltungen im In- und Ausland, wenn erforderlich 

 Gelegentliche Reisen zu unserem Hauptsitz in Utrecht, Niederlande, gehören zur Rolle 

 Büropräsenz an 3–4 Tagen pro Monat
 
 

 Was wir bieten 
 Variable Vergütung zusätzlich zu Deinem monatlichen Gehalt 

 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr, plus einen jährlichen dreitägigen Firmenausflug 

 1 freiwilliger Tag pro Jahr, um Dich ehrenamtlich zu engagieren 

 Ein Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.500 € pro Kalenderjahr für persönliche Entwicklung und Karrierewachstum 

 Attraktive Altersvorsorge bei Allianz mit einem Arbeitgeberanteil von 5 % 

 Freie, aber nicht verpflichtende tägliche Nutzung unseres deutschen Büros – Anwesenheit ist erforderlich bei regelmäßigen, im Voraus

jobs.title: Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
jobs.description:
About BJAK 
 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 
  
 The Role 
 We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Stockbroking.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Lead product direction for major AI Stockbroking areas.

 Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

 Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, KYB - MoonPay Enterprise
jobs.description:
MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove. 

 This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 

 MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes. 

 AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters. 

 You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together. 

 The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100 , made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running. 
 

 About MoonPay Enterprise

 MoonPay Enterprise is one of the more operationally complex products in the stablecoin space: multiple banking providers, multiple payment rails, a growing partner base across two product lines (Orchestration and Issuance), and an active compliance surface across each. MoonPay Enterprise runs B2B, B2B2B, and B2B2C models. Partners integrate our API. Their customers become direct customers of MoonPay Enterprise for compliance purposes.

 KYB is the front door. Every partner is a business. Every business customer of every partner clears KYB before a single transaction moves. Today the flow is part automated registry verification, part manual review, with different rules for the US and the rest of the world, and turnaround measured in days. That does not scale to where MoonPay Enterprise is going. KYB has to become a product: measurable, fast, API-first, defensible in front of regulators and banking partners. This is a principal seat. You set the multi-year direction for how businesses enter MoonPay Enterprise, and you own the outcome.

 What You'll Own

 KYB product strategy & roadmap

 
 
 Business onboarding end-to-end, across every model MoonPay Enterprise runs: partners onboarding onto MoonPay Enterprise, businesses onboarding directly, and business customers onboarding through partners.

 
 Platform altitude. KYB decisions ripple into KYC, Travel Rule capture, banking-provider onboarding, and Issuance partner diligence. Connect the surfaces; don't optimise one in isolation.

 
 MoonPay Enterprise runs three KYC delivery models (reliance, outsourcing, hosted). KYB coverage is uneven across them. You decide where it expands and in what order.

 
 Genuine product depth on MoonPay Enterprise is non-negotiable. Within weeks you talk fluently about KYB outcomes, UBO requirements, virtual account structures, and API behaviour. From being hands-on, not from documentation.

 
 Onboarding funnel & conversion

 
 
 The KYB funnel is yours: pass rate, time-to-verified against a 48-72h target, manual review rate, drop-off per step.

 
 Instrument what isn't instrumented. Make approval speed and rejection quality measurable. Then move both.

 
 Fix rejection UX. Today a declined business often gets a status without a reason, and the partner escalates to support to find out what is missing. Rejection reasons, retry semantics, and resubmission flows become API surface partners build on.

 
 KYB API & partner experience

 
 
 The KYB API surface: statuses, webhooks, document submission, and the edge cases that make business onboarding hard (sole proprietors, corporate shareholders, one person who is UBO, Director, and Representative at once).

 
 Partners integrate KYB in weeks and self-serve their onboarding questions. Every "what is missing for this customer" escalation is a product gap. Close it.

 
 Compliance as product

 
 
 Turn compliance-approved onboarding matrices into product logic. US and non-US differ: control prong versus directors, when ownership documents are required, self-certification options. Partners should never need to read a matrix.

 
 EDD triggers, high-risk classification, prohibited industries, Travel Rule capture: you decide how they show up in the product.

 
 Compliance is your sparring partner, not a ticket queue. You shape how policy becomes product. They own the policy.

 
 Vendor & provider orchestration

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (EMEA or USA)
jobs.description:
Company Overview: 

 At Panopto, we are the most customer-centric learning technology company in the world. As the leader in visual and audio-based learning , we empower organizations to share knowledge effortlessly in a capture and post-capture world. We don’t just build software; we obsess over our users’ goals to deliver solutions that truly matter. Our mission is simple: to attract the brightest talent, people like you, to Elevate the Craft and do the most impactful work of your career. 

 
 

 Panopto is looking for a Senior Project Manager to own the execution behind our product initiatives — from the moment we commit to something through the day customers can use it. 

 Position Summary 

 In this role, you will have the opportunity to do the most impactful work of your career, elevating your craft while contributing to a team that values lifelong learning. 

 As the Senior Project Manager, you'll report to the Program Manager and sit inside the Product team on the R&D side, which means the job runs in both directions. Upstream, you're working with Product Managers, Engineering, and Design to keep committed work moving, dependencies visible, and slippage caught early. Downstream, you're making sure Marketing has positioning, Support knows what's changing, Sales can sell it, and customers hear about it the day it goes live. 

 

 Most project management roles are one or the other. This one is deliberately both, because the handoffs between them are where things fall apart. 

 You'll take initiatives that start as a paragraph and a target quarter, break them into a plan people can act on, and keep a distributed group of teams moving in the same direction until it's out the door. This role is for someone energized rather than frustrated by ambiguity — you'll frequently be the person who turns "we're doing this next quarter" into a sequenced plan with owners and dates, and then holds everyone to it. 

 You’ll also have opportunities to contribute to other initiatives that directly advance our core values and support you in elevating your craft. 

 How You’ll Contribute 

 In this role, you will have the opportunity to 

 
 
 Own the end-to-end plan for assigned initiatives — scope, sequence, dependencies, milestones, and readiness criteria from commitment through release. 

 
 Break large, ambiguous initiatives into discrete workstreams with clear owners, and keep the group aligned as things shift. 

 
 Work alongside Product Managers and Engineering Leads to track delivery against commitments, surface slippage early, and keep cross-team dependencies visible and resolved. 

 
 Facilitate the sessions that move work forward — dependency reviews, cross-team planning, release readiness — and make sure they end in decisions. 

 
 Translate engineering blockers and technical trade-offs into clear, honest updates for Product leadership and commercial stakeholders. 

 
 Drive go-to-market readiness with Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, Support, and Customer Success so enablement lands with the release, not after it. 

 
 Coordinate internal and customer-facing release communications, including release notes. 

 
 Build the templates, checklists, and repeatable processes that make the next release easier than the last one — using AI tooling to cut the manual overhead. 

 
 

 What Success Looks Like 

 
 
 Within 3 months: You've built working relationships across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Support, and you own end-to-end coordination for two or more active initiatives — running the delivery cadence with the dev teams and producing status reporting people actually read. 

 
 Within 6 months: You're anticipating blockers rather than reporting them, and releases you coordinate go out with GTM readiness in place on day one. 

 
 Within 1 year: You run our most complex, multi-team initiatives with minimal oversight, and the delivery and launch process you've built is what the rest of the team uses by default. 

 
 Your legacy: Panopto ships predictably, and every team knows what's coming and what they need to do about it — because you built the system that makes that true. 

 
 Values in Action 

 
 
 Customer First, Always : You proactively surface friction points in the customer experience before they are escalated — and propose solutions, not just reports. 

 
 Thrive Together : You share work-in-progress for early feedback, knowing that challenge improves the outcome. You separate critiques of ideas from critiques of people. 

 
 Elevate the Craft : You hold the bar high on your own work and invest in developing those around you. You treat every project as an opportunity to learn something new. 

 
 Act with Ownership : You define success by outcomes, not activity. You flag problems early and bring a proposed path forward, not just the problem. 

 
 Clarity Over Complexity : You default to the simpler solution. Your written communication — internal or external — is direct, specific, and free of fil

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (CRM & Growth)
jobs.description:
About Lendable
 Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:
 
 One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

 Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

 Profitable since 2017 

 Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs 

 Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot )

 
 So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance . We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.
 
 We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes. 
 
 Join us if you want to
 Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

 Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

 Build the best technology in-house : we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 
 About the role 
 Every email and notification we send is part of how customers experience Lendable, and a 5.0★ Trustpilot rating across more than 100,000 reviews sets a high bar for it: communication has to be clear, timely and honest. As our Senior Product Manager for CRM & Growth, you'll own the products and systems that shape how customers hear from us across their lifecycle, from first interaction through to retention and reactivation.
 Product here isn't backlog grooming. The trade-offs are commercial as much as they are user-facing: engagement, retention, conversion, cost to serve and customer experience all pull against each other, and you'll make the calls. There will always be more good ideas than capacity, so sharp prioritisation is central to the job. The role also has a real technical edge. Messaging reliability, deliverability and platform integrations are part of what you'll own, so you'll need to be comfortable going deep with engineers. Teams here are small relative to the size of the book we run, so you'll carry more scope and ownership than the same title would at a larger, more layered company.

 What you'll be doing 
 Owning the roadmap and outcomes for our CRM and lifecycle product: onboarding, engagement, retention and reactivation

 Prioritising a pipeline of competing opportunities across CRM, growth, deliverability and platform work, weighing expected impact, effort and risk, and being clear about what we won't do

 Taking products and channel improvements from problem definition through to launch and iteration, owning both the product and technical decisions alongside Engineering

 Defining the metrics that matter and making the commercial trade-offs between growth, retention, cost and customer experience, and making sure performance is measurable end to end, from tracking and data flows through to dashboards the wider business can trust

 Running an experimentation programme: writing clear hypotheses, designing A/B tests, and using SQL and our data to measure true incremental impact

 Treating email deliverability and messaging reliability as product concerns, working with Engineering on infrastructure, platform integrations and cost efficiency

 Shaping requirements with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Risk and Compliance so that what we ship is effective and meets the standards expected of a regulated lender

 Holding a high bar for what customers receive: clear, honest content, well-tested design, and rigorous checks before and after launch.

 What we're looking for 

 Essential 
 5+ years in product management, with substantial experience in CRM, lifecycle, messaging or growth for a consumer product at meaningful scale

 Strong product management fundamentals: you've taken a product or channel from problem definition through launch and iteration, and owned both the product and the technical sides of delivery

 Excellent prioritisation: a clear, defensible way of ranking competing opportunities by expected impact, effort and risk, the confidence to say no, and the ability to explain trade-offs to stakeholders

 A track record of owning measurable outcomes in engagement, retention or revenue, not just shipping features

 Strong SQL and analytical skills, and experience designing and interpreting A/B tests, with the habit of measuring impact rigorously rather than relying on vanity metrics

 Enough technical depth to work credibly with engineers on messaging infrastructure, deliverability and platform integrations, and clear communication across technical and commercial audiences

 Nice to have 
 Experience in fina

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Generative AI Platform
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure 

 
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

 Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat. DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt now operate as one global company. Behind the AI experiences millions of people use every day, from shopping assistants to customer support agents, sits one shared Generative AI platform. Our team builds it.

 We're looking for a Staff Product Manager in London to own major parts of that platform. Your customers are the engineers and ML researchers across all three brands who build AI products and agents. You'll work with engineering and product leaders in Europe and the US, and your decisions will shape how AI gets built across every market we operate in.

 What You'll Be Doing

 
 Set the strategy and roadmap for core parts of our GenAI platform: model access and routing, agent infrastructure, and evaluation and observability.

 Build one platform for three brands. Spot the patterns across Deliveroo, Wolt and DoorDash teams and turn them into shared building blocks, so a capability built once reaches every market.

 Shape our model portfolio across frontier and open-weight models. Decide where we build, buy or partner in an ecosystem that changes month to month.

 Make agents production-ready. Give teams safe access to company knowledge, tools and systems, with the quality, latency and cost controls needed to run agents at scale.

 Own the evaluation strategy so teams can prove quality before launch and keep improving it after.

 Stay close to your customers. Work with the teams shipping AI experiences, measure adoption and time-to-production, and let real production use drive the roadmap.

 Lead at a senior level, presenting to senior technical leadership and influence strategy beyond your own roadmap.

 
 What You'll Need to Thrive

 Our ideal candidate brings deep expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

 
 Significant product management experience (typically 8+ years, or equivalent), including owning a technical platform, developer product, or ML or data infrastructure.

 Hands-on experience with LLM-based products or platforms in production, such as assistants, agents, evaluation or inference. GenAI platforms are a young field, so we care more about depth than years.

 A platform mindset. You notice the problem five teams keep solving and turn it into one capability everyone can use.

 The ability to go deep with engineers and ML researchers, then explain the trade-off in plain language to a senior leader.

 A track record of leading large, ambiguous areas on your own and aligning stakeholders across companies, countries and time zones.

 Comfort with regular overlap with US time zones, including some late-afternoon and evening calls.

 
 What Success Looks Like

 A team in any of our three brands can go from idea to a reliable AI product dramatically faster. That happens because the hard parts (models, inference, evaluation, tooling, observability, governance and agent infrastructure) are solved once at the platform layer and get better for everyone.

 Why Join Us?

 
 Real scale from day one. Your platform powers AI used by millions of consumers, merchants and couriers across three brands.

 Frontier work, real constraints. You'll work with the latest models and agent patterns, then make them reliable, affordable and compliant in production.

 Visible impact. Platform decisions here get reviewed by senior leadership and adopted across the company.

 
 

 We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

 🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

 💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

jobs.title: Senior Carrier and Product Management
jobs.description:
Die Position 
 Du verbindest Cyberversicherung, Produktentwicklung und Carrier-Steuerung. In dieser Schlüsselrolle verantwortest du das Versicherungsportfolio und die MGA-Partnerschaften von Eye Security und entwickelst skalierbare Lösungen für unsere europäischen Märkte
 
 Deine Aufgaben 
 Produktmanagement 
 Du entwickelst unsere Cyber-Versicherungsprodukte in Deutschland, den Niederlanden, Österreich und weiteren Ländern weiter und verknüpfst sie eng mit unserem Cyber-Guard- und Incident-Response-Angebot. Bei Bedarf koordinierst du externe Partner.

 Du verfolgst Markt-, Carrier- und Brokertrends und passt Produkte sowie Bedingungswerke gezielt an.

 Du unterstützt das Underwriting-Team und unsere Kunden bei rechtlichen und versicherungstechnischen Fragen.

 Du erkennst Compliance-Risiken in allen Märkten frühzeitig und setzt rechtskonforme Lösungen für die jeweilige Rechtsordnung um.

 Du treibst die Einführung eines modularen Produktkonzepts voran und skalierst Abläufe durch Automatisierung.

 
 Carrier Management 
 Du steuerst das Carrier Management rechtlich und strategisch. Du verhandelst und verantwortest den Abschluss von Assekuradeurverträgen in der EU und im Vereinigten Königreich und steuerst Kapazitäten für KMU und Großrisiken.

 Du baust eine stabile, langfristige und diversifizierte Carrier-Basis auf, die unserem Geschäftsmodell bestmöglich entspricht.

 Du verantwortest alle MGA-Verträge, koordinierst Verlängerungen und baust ein Claims-Management auf, das unsere Profitabilitätsziele mit den Anforderungen der Carrier verbindet.

 
 Dein Profil 
 Du verfügst über fundiertes juristisches Wissen im Bereich Cyber-Versicherung in Deutschland, den Niederlanden oder einem anderen EU-Land. Eine juristische Qualifikation als Rechtsanwalt beziehungsweise vergleichbare juristische Expertise ist ein Plus.

 Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung mit Cyber-Produkten und Bedingungswerken aus dem Underwriting und/oder der Schadenabwicklung mit.

 Du verstehst Cyber-Compliance und regulatorische Anforderungen und hast praktische Erfahrung mit Incident-Response- und Präventionslösungen.

 Du denkst unternehmerisch, arbeitest strukturiert und detailorientiert und möchtest etwas aufbauen und skalieren.

 Du arbeitest selbstständig, trittst sicher auf und bist verlässlich. Es gelingt dir, andere mitzunehmen.

 Du verhandelst souverän mit Kunden und Partnern, bist belastbar und übernimmst Verantwortung.

 Du kommunizierst sicher auf Englisch sowie auf Deutsch oder Niederländisch.

 
 Das bieten wir dir 
 Eine Schlüsselrolle in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Cybersecurity-Scale-ups Europas.

 Die Möglichkeit, eine innovative Cybersecurity-Produktlinie mitzugestalten, die wirksame Cybersicherheit und Cyber-Versicherung global verbindet.

 Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket inklusive Bonus.

 Flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance.

 Car Allowance.

 Wahlfreiheit bei deiner Ausstattung: MacBook oder Dell Laptop sowie iPhone oder Android-Smartphone.

 Aktive Unterstützung deiner persönlichen und fachlichen Weiterentwicklung.

 Die Zusammenarbeit mit erstklassigen Cybersecurity-Expert:innen in unserem internationalen CERT-Team.

 
 Über Eye Security 
 Eye Security bietet Unternehmen in Europa Cybersicherheit mit integrierten Cyberversicherungslösungen. Unser Team vereint Fachleute mit Erfahrung in den Bereichen Nachrichtendienst, Militär, Technologie und Beratung. Sie alle verbindet eine gemeinsame Mission: Cybersicherheit auf Enterprise-Niveau für jedes Unternehmen zugänglich zu machen – nicht nur für die Großen.
 Eye Security wurde 2020 in Den Haag gegründet und vereint Managed Detection and Response, ein rund um die Uhr von Menschen betriebenes Security Operations Center (SOC), schnelle Incident Response und eine eigene Cyberversicherung auf einer einzigen Plattform. Das Unternehmen betreut Organisationen in den Niederlanden, Belgien und Deutschland und baut seine Plattform sowie den Marktzugang in ganz Europa aus.
 Eye Security wird von Bessemer Venture Partners, J.P. Morgan Growth Equity Partners und TIN Capital unterstützt. Zuletzt nahm das Unternehmen in einer von Sofina angeführten Series-C-Finanzierungsrunde 60 Millionen Euro auf.
