jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – Digital Clients: Growth & Expansion
jobs.description:
Your Role
 As Senior Product Manager – Private Wealth (f/m/d) you build the product for LIQID's most demanding clients: entrepreneurs, families and executives whose relationship with us runs through a personal Relationship Manager. You design for two users at once – the client and the RM – and your mandate is twofold: make our Relationship Managers radically more effective, and design the end-to-end hybrid service, sales and relationship model for our most complex offerings. Our private clients hold portfolios that include private equity funds from KKR, EQT, CVC and Permira and venture stakes in companies like SpaceX, OpenAI, Stripe and Anduril. You make sure that advising on, investing in and living with these portfolios feels like the best of private banking – with the speed and clarity of a digital product.
 
 What you'll do
 End-to-End Segment Ownership: Own the private client journey from introduction and first advisory meeting through onboarding, investment and long-term servicing to the next allocation. You define the segment's North Star and KPI tree – net new money, share of wallet, time from advisory to investment, private markets adoption, retention, RM book capacity and cost-to-serve – and develop it further where you see sharper signals.

 RM Enablement & Advisory Tooling: Treat Relationship Managers as users, not stakeholders. You build the tools that give them more time for advice and less for administration: a client 360 view, meeting preparation and follow-up, next-best-action signals, pipeline visibility and AI copilots that draft, summarize and document – within the requirements of MiFID II on suitability, cost transparency and record-keeping.

 Hybrid Service & Sales Design: Blueprint the service model end-to-end: which moments are digital, which are personal, and which are both. Together with RM and Sales leadership you design seamless handovers, a shared view between client app and RM workspace, and service tiers that scale high-touch quality to more clients without diluting it.

 Complex Offerings, Made Simple: Make sophisticated products understandable and executable: private markets with capital calls, distributions and J-curves, and the underlying funds and companies, from Cinven and Advent to Mistral and Databricks, as well as bespoke mandates, company and holding accounts, family structures and consolidated reporting across portfolios. You work closely with the Investment team, Compliance and Operations so every journey is compliant by design.

 Discovery, Data & Experimentation: Join advisory meetings, shadow RMs and run continuous discovery with clients for whom every interaction matters. You combine qualitative depth with rigorous measurement in a small-n, high-value segment, define tracking schemas for client and RM journeys, and use AI-assisted prototyping to converge on solutions in few iteration cycles.

 Thought Leadership with Hands-on Mentality: Act as Product Manager and Product Owner for a cross-functional team of Engineering, Design and Product Ops. You drive adoption of what you ship inside the RM organization, prioritize transparently by impact and effort – which also means saying no – and grow into the thought leader for hybrid wealth management at LIQID.

 
 What you bring
 Background: 7+ years in Product Management, ideally in wealth management, private banking, FinTech or another trust-driven, advice-led domain. Experience building for internal expert users such as advisors, sales or service teams alongside end clients is a strong plus.

 Service Design & Hybrid Thinking: You think in service models, not just screens. You have designed journeys that span people, processes and software, and you know how to drive adoption and behavior change inside an organization, not only ship features to it.

 Domain Depth & Regulatory Fluency: Solid understanding of investing and wealth management (capital markets, private markets, portfolio construction), and the ambition to build regulatory fluency in a supervised environment (MiFID II, BaFin). Experience with private market products or advisory processes is a strong plus.

 Analytical & Technical Fluency: You define metrics before you build and attribute impact credibly, even with small samples. You are comfortable with CRM and workflow integrations, discussing architecture and API trade-offs with engineers, and using AI tooling to prototype and to build AI-assisted workflows.

 Communication & Language: Fluent in German and English , with the presence to earn credibility with experienced Relationship Managers and with clients who expect the highest standard – and to represent your roadmap toward leadership.

 Drive & Motivation: Comfortable in fast-paced, high-ownership scale-up environments. You want to own outcomes, not backlogs, and you are excited to define what a premium hybrid private client experience looks like in an AI-native product organization.

 
 What we offer 
 Diversity : Flat hierarchies and cultural open

jobs.title: Senior Manager Product Cost Optimization – Prozesse & Industrialisierung (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
About The Company

GROPYUS is a technology-based construction company focused on building multi-story residential buildings. Thanks to its prefabricated building system with a wide range of design options, automated offsite construction, and fully digitalized processes, the company is able to create resilient timber housing quickly and cost-effectively. GROPYUS is using scalable construction and manufacturing solutions to tap into a future market, strengthen Europe’s innovation capacity, and play a substantial role in improving sustainability. The company delivers its multi-family houses as a complete and turnkey solution. The combination of technology, construction, robotics, and manufacturing expertise means buildings can be created in a fully digitalized end-to-end process. The building system is based on versatile wall and slab elements, making it easier to optimize land use, customize plans, and build fast with both off-site construction and on-site assembly. This system is complemented by the Building Operating System–developed in-house.

Über die Rolle

Werde Teil von GROPYUS und gestalte aktiv die Kostenwettbewerbsfähigkeit unserer innovativen Gebäudesysteme. An der Schnittstelle von Produktentwicklung, Engineering, Fertigung, Einkauf und Bauausführung identifizierst und realisierst du Kostensenkungspotenziale über den gesamten Lebenszyklus unserer Gebäude hinweg.

Als Senior Manager Cost Optimization - Building Systems spielst du eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau transparenter Kostenstrukturen, der kritischen Bewertung technischer Lösungen sowie der Umsetzung von Value-Engineering-Initiativen über unser gesamtes Produktportfolio hinweg.

Diese Position richtet sich insbesondere an Kandidat:innen aus der Automobil-, Luftfahrt- oder Schiffbauindustrie, dem industriellen Fertigungsumfeld oder anderen Lean-geprägten Branchen. Du bringst einen nachweislichen Erfolgsausweis in den Bereichen Kostenoptimierung, Value Engineering und Operational Excellence mit und unterstützt die weitere Industrialisierung unserer Gebäudesysteme.

Dein Aufgabenbereich umfasst:

  • Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Kostenoptimierungsstrategie für unsere Gebäudesysteme, um Kostenwettbewerbsfähigkeit und Wertschöpfung über das gesamte Produktportfolio hinweg sicherzustellen.
  • Anwendung von Design-to-Cost-, Should-Cost-, Value-Engineering- und Target-Costing-Methoden in den Bereichen Produktentwicklung, Fertigung, Einkauf und Bauausführung.
  • Identifikation, Analyse und Priorisierung von Kostenoptimierungspotenzialen für Gebäudesysteme, Komponenten, Materialien sowie Schnittstellen in der Bauausführung.
  • Entwicklung und Pflege transparenter Kostenmodelle und Benchmarks sowie Sicherstellung eines kontinuierlichen Lernprozesses auf Basis von Soll-Ist-Kostenvergleichen.
  • Steuerung bereichsübergreifender Kostenoptimierungsinitiativen und Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung von Verbesserungsmaßnahmen.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams aus Product, Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, Construction und R&D, um Kostenbewusstsein nachhaltig in Entscheidungsprozessen zu verankern.

 

Über dich

Minimale Voraussetzungen

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in den Bereichen Cost Engineering, Product Costing, Value Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operational Excellence oder Kostenoptimierung innerhalb der Automobil-, Luftfahrt- oder Schiffbauindustrie, im Lean Manufacturing, in Produktionsumgebungen mit hohen Stückzahlen oder vergleichbar anspruchsvollen industriellen Umfeldern.
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Anwendung von Lean-Manufacturing-Prinzipien und Continuous-Improvement-Methoden zur Realisierung messbarer Verbesserungen bei Kosten, Produktivität und Effizienz.
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge bei der Umsetzung messbarer Kostensenkungen und nachhaltiger Geschäftsergebnisse durch bereichsübergreifende Initiativen.
  • Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Lösungen in wirtschaftliche Auswirkungen zu übersetzen.
  • Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Geschäftsreisen zwischen unseren Standorten.
  • Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse.

Bevorzugte Voraussetzungen

  • Erfahrung mit industrialisiertem Bauen, modularen Gebäudesystemen oder vorgefertigten Wohnlösungen.
  • Kenntnisse im Holzbau, der deutschsprachigen Baumärkte sowie digitaler Kalkulations- und Costing-Tools.
  • Gutes Verständnis von Bauverfahren, Baumaterialien, Schnittstellen zu Nachunternehmern sowie den wesentlichen Kostentreibern von Bauprojekten.
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager, Salesforce (6-7 months Maternity Cover)  (all genders)
Product Manager
jobs.description:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented. 
 
The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.
 
We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n.
 
We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.
 
 The Role 
 You own Banking Experience: the accounts at the center of customer's relationship with the bank, and the API and dashboards they use to manage them.
 In this role you’re responsible for redefining what beautiful software in banking looks like. You'll define account structures that give customers powerful building blocks for their products, and craft intuitive interfaces grounded in a deep understanding of their use cases and workflows.
 You report to Will, Head of Product, and work closely with Simon, our CTO. You're expected to operate with full autonomy on your team's roadmap, collaborating with design and engineering.
 
 Your First Six Months 
 Months 1-2: Take over day-to-day ownership of the Banking Experience team - the roadmap, the ways of working, the hard decisions. Establish yourself with customers and how they use our accounts. You define and ship your first project.

 Months 3-4: Execution mode. You're unblocking engineering daily, making hard prioritization calls, and shipping your roadmap to customers. You're proactively raising the bar across accounts, API, and dashboard by feeding what you learn from customers into the product.

 Months 5-6: You're working with live customers on the products you've built. Deposits and number of account holders are scaling. You've moved from execution to platform mode - evolving the roadmap based on what our customers are building on top of Augustus.

 
 Who Will Thrive At Augustus 
 We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits:
 American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.

 Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.

 Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.

 Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.

 This role is for you if: 
 You want to spend time with customers to intimately understand and then innovate on their workflows.

 You’re a structured and relentless problem solver.

 You combine first-principles thinking with deep domain knowledge to make complex processes simple.

 You have taste and care deeply about the quality of what you build.

 You leverage AI to push the boundaries of what a PM can do.

 You’re excited about building a programmable bank and helping shape what that means.

 
 Hard Requirements 
 Experience end-to-end owning and building banking, fintech, or developer platform products.

 Technical enough to spar on architectural decisions with engineers - you're comfortable in API design discussions, not just UI reviews.

 You have experience with control planes, dashboards, or console products at infrastructure, finance, or developer tools companies.

 You have strong opinions on information architecture and how to organize complex products so they feel simple

 Comfortable in customer-facing roles - you've pitched, demoed, and closed early adopters yourself.

 Based in New York or Berlin, or willing to relocate.

 
 Pay transparency 
 Compensation packages at Augustus include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise and geographic location.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Parental Leave Cover (Fixed-Term, 12 Months)
jobs.description:
About Staffbase

We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first AI-native Employee Experience Platform. Our industry-leading and award-winning agentic AI communications channels - intranet, employee app and email solutions - create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees.

Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany and New York City, with offices in Berlin, London, Sydney, Tokyo, Prague, and Minneapolis–St. Paul, our diverse team of 550+ employees supports 1,500+ customers—reaching over 14 million employees—in transforming their employee experience.
We are proud to be a Unicorn company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we’re shaping the future of workplace communication.

At Staffbase, we're moving beyond communication into a new frontier: helping millions of frontline and deskless employees not just find information, but actually get things done. The Actions team owns that execution layer - the bridge between employees, Staffbase AI, and the real operational work happening in stores, warehouses, hospitals, and in the field.

Our biggest bet right now is Tasks - the product that lets an enterprise's HQ push operational standards to thousands of locations and see them executed on the ground, driven by a major new partnership. Around it sits a portfolio of agentic actions, forms, and HR workflows that make Staffbase a place where work happens, not just where it's announced.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to seize this moment. This is a 12-month fixed-term role - and we mean that as a feature. It's a rare chance to make an outsized, visible impact on Staffbase's expansion into operational territory, with senior leadership attention and real revenue behind it, without signing up for the long corporate haul. If you're a builder who loves 0-to-1 energy and wants to point it at a concrete, high-stakes problem for a year, this is for you.

You're a commercially-minded generalist, comfortable in ambiguity, fast-moving, and able to hold the whole picture - customer, business case, and build - in your head at once.

  • Bring an AI-native lens throughout - where an intelligent layer genuinely unblocks a worker, and where it's just noise

 Beratung 
 Als Project Manager übernimmst Du die Leitung von Projekten oder komplexen Teilprojekten.  Als Experte überblickst und managst Du Projekte ganzheitlich. Zu Deinen Aufgaben zählen die Planung sowie die Durchführung und Steuerung. Du übernimmst zudem die Kommunikation und Vertretung des Projektes auf Leitungsebene und nach außen.
 Führungsverantwortung 
 Intern und auf Projekten führst Du Kollegen und Mitarbeiter. Deine Erfahrung gibst Du in Form von Coachings und Workshops weiter. Zudem teilst Du Deine Expertise in Form von Veröffentlichungen, die in Fachmedien veröffentlicht werden.

 Du hast Spaß daran, komplexe Problemstellungen zu strukturieren, nachhaltige Lösungen zu entwickeln und zu deren zielgerichteter Umsetzung beizutragen. Du steuerst dabei Projektvorhaben von der Initiierung bis zur erfolgreichen Verankerung in der Organisation.
 Was wir uns vor Du wünschen:
 Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit Schwerpunkt Finance/Recht oder eine Ausbildung im Finanzbereich

 Mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche und im Management von Projekten

 Erfahrung in der Steuerung von (Teil-)Projekten und Projektteams

 Qualifikation/Zertifizierung im Projektmanagement (z. B. Scrum, IPMA, PMI)

 Nachgewiesene Expertise in mindestens einem Schwerpunktbereich (Regulatorik, Risikomanagement, Wertpapiergeschäft, IT-Management)

 Hohe Problemlösungskompetenz und Begeisterungsfähigkeit

 Motivation sich ständig weiterzuentwickeln und Verantwortung zu übernehmen

 Versierter Umgang mit MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

 Teamplayer-Mentalität

 Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1)

 Reisebereitschaft

 Deine Benefits
 Flexibilität: Montags und dienstags kannst Du bequem von zu Hause arbeiten, wobei Dir unser Büro dennoch jederzeit offensteht. In dringenden Fällen ist Home-Office auch an anderen Tagen möglich. Wir legen großen Wert auf persönliche Interaktionen und passen uns flexibel den Bedürfnissen unserer Kunden an.
 Weiterbildung: Du hast die Freiheit, passende Trainings, Seminare und Weiterbildungen nach Deinen Präferenzen auszuwählen. Zusätzlich bieten wir interne, mitarbeitergeführte Fortbildungen und Workshops an.
 Onboarding: Ab Tag 1 statten wir Dich mit einem Laptop, einem modernem Smartphone, das Du auch privat nutzen kannst, und einer Kreditkarte für Deine beruflichen Nebenkosten aus.
 Coaching: Für Deine Weiterentwicklung steht Dir ein Counsellor zur Seite, mit dem Du deine persönlichen Ziele formulierst und der Dich bei der eigenen Karriereentwicklung mit seinen Erfahrungen bestmöglich unterstützt.
 Gesundheit: Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen. Deshalb heißt es bei uns jeden Donnerstag: Massagetag! Ein geschulter Masseur und Osteopath kommt einmal in der Woche zu uns ins Büro. Darüber hinaus sind unsere Büros mit höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen ausgestattet.

Diese Erlebnisse fördern den Teamgeist, schaffen gemeinsame Erfahrungen und bieten großartige Gelegenheiten, sich besser kennenzulernen.

 Urlaub: 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr, um sich zu erholen und neue Energie zu tanken.

 Corporate Benefits: Du erhältst vergünstigte Mitarbeiterangebote auf z.B. Reisen, Mode, Technik und Veranstaltungen.
 Spaß und Nervennahrung: Bei uns werden herausfordernde Arbeitstage durch packende Tischkicker-Turniere, Gespräche in der Küche und eine gesunde Dosis Vitamine aufgepeppt.

jobs.title: Product Owner Finance
jobs.description:
About Weezevent
 From iconic festivals such as Tomorrowland, Lollapalooza, BBK, and Boomtown to major sporting events like the Mexico GP or the Paris 2024 Olympic and Paralympic Games, Weezevent supports events of all sizes and formats.
 We are the French leader in online ticketing and the European leader in cashless payments. Through all the companies forming up the Weezevent Group, we offer a comprehensive suite of solutions including access control , CRM and staff management, used across a wide variety of events all over the world.
 Founded in 2008, Weezevent received the European Fast 500 Innovation Award in 2014 and was included in the French Tech Next40 ranking in both 2024 and 2025. Today, the group employs over 180 people across France, the UK, Spain, Switzerland, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, Portugal and Canada, and deploys its solutions at around 1.000 major events each year.
 Weezevent is looking for a Product Owner Finance (M/F based in Clichy).
 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Product Vision and Strategy : execute the overall vision and strategy for financial products (from ticketing sells to cashless payments, financial reporting, fiscal reporting, and accounting), ensuring alignment with business goals, country regulations and market demands.
 Stakeholder Collaboration : act as the primary liaison between stakeholders (finance, compliance, sales, marketing) and the development team to gather requirements and prioritize features. 
Detect and report payments incidents when impacting organizers appreciation.
Communicate the product vision and strategy effectively to stakeholders and team members.
Provide operational support to the Client success and Finance teams. Providing help for PSP configurations, responding to questions in Slack, triaging RUN requests and generating custom exports is key for the well functioning of the company.
 Product Backlog Management : create, maintain, and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, customer feedback, market trends, and regulatory requirements.
Write clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria for the development team.
 Development and Delivery : work closely with the development team during sprints to ensure the product is being built according to specifications and timelines. 
Review, QA and accept completed user stories to ensure they meet the acceptance criteria and deliver the expected value.
 Market and User Research : analyze user data and metrics to inform product decisions and identify areas for improvement, particularly in payments technology.
 Compliance and Risk Management : ensure that financial products comply with relevant country/tax/fiscal regulations, standards, and best practices, including GDPR, PCI-DSS, and other industry-specific requirements.
Identify and mitigate risks associated with financial products and solutions with a strong emphasis on compliance and regulatory adherence.
 Performance Monitoring : monitor product performance and customer satisfaction, using data and analytics to track key performance indicators. 
Implement changes and improvements based on performance metrics and user feedback.
 
 Why it's a good move ? 
You will be responsible for executing the vision, strategy, and roadmap for finance functionalities, infrastructure and operational capabilities related to all our products. This role involves collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, developers, designers, and business stakeholders, to ensure the successful delivery of financial products that meet market needs and regulatory requirements, with a strong focus on compliance.
 
 Fundamentals to join us :
 You have a Master’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field. MBA or relevant certification (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner) ; 

 You have +5 years of experience as a Product Owner, Consultant, or similar role, in a start-up, company or function where payment is core. Having a strong understanding of payments & financial concepts, markets, and instruments is mandatory.

 You have a proven track record of managing all aspects of a successful product throughout its lifecycle.

 You speak French fluently.

 Just like you, we prefer to work with energetic, friendly and highly committed person. Take on new challenges in a creative sector, send us your CV and let's talk !
 All of our positions are open to people with disabilities. 
 Compensation and benefits
 We offer a salary of EUR 50,400–65,000 per year for this permanent contract based in Clichy with a hybrid working arrangement. Private health insurance is provided to cover your medical needs. Public transportation benefits support your daily commute. Paid sick leave ensures you have time to recover when needed. Home Office options offer flexibility in your weekly schedule. A casual dress code allows you to wear what makes you comfortable at work. Regular team events and social activities keep you connected with colleagues.

jobs.title: Founding lead Product Designer
jobs.description:
Raison is on a mission to provide humans with better skills so they can feel confident and have more opportunities in the AI era. We help companies make sure 100% their teams master AI, directly in the flow of work (Teams, Slack) so that AI knowledge spreads across the organization instead of pooling in a handful of champions. 

 We are passionate entrepreneurs believing that the ongoing AI revolution should be shared by all employees; and that the future of corporate interactions should not be restricted to private human-machine chats. Raison is capturing what champions create with AI, turning it into shared, governed skills, and propagating them so everyone feels capable and empowered; acting as a powerful lever to accelerate the AI transformation of corporates. 

 We recently raised €2m from a top French VC + BPI and a selection of high-profile business angels who believe AI mastery is the highest-leverage application of AI inside companies.

 Tasks

 User Research & Discovery 

 
 Own field research: contextual inquiry, user interviews, and observation of how teams actually work with AI and where it breaks.

 Build and maintain a deep understanding of our core users — individual contributors, champions, managers, and corporate buyers — and the context they operate in.

 Synthesize messy field data into sharp, actionable insight: jobs-to-be-done, adoption blockers, and the conditions under which a skill transfers between people.

 Establish a continuous discovery habit so research is a foundational reflex, and champion the user's perspective in every product decision.

 
  

 Product & Experience Design 

 
 What our experts do by hand today is the spec for what the product must automate tomorrow. Your job is to watch that closely enough to design it.

 Design the surfaces: the client dashboard execs present to their board, the internal console our experts use to run a dozen live communities at once, and the conversations themselves.

 Most of our product lives inside someone else's client. You are designing in Teams and Slack, not screens we control — no onboarding, no landing page, no second chance. A four-minute message to an accountant who has never opened Copilot is the hardest design problem we have.

 Work mostly on enterprise, and partly on higher education, where we also have live deployments. Two audiences, two vocabularies, one product: part of your job is deciding what stays shared and what has to differ, so we build one coherent system rather than two half-products.

 Work hand-in-hand with our AI product engineers so your field learnings ship as features, then get re-tested at the next pilot.

 Own the design system: components, tokens, patterns, and the copy that goes with them.

 
 Requirements

 
 4–8 years in product design, UX design, or a hybrid design-research role, ideally on complex, multi-user B2B products.

 A strong portfolio that shows both craft and thinking: we want to see how you operated, not just what shipped.

 A skilled researcher who can design a study, run it in the wild, and turn qualitative chaos into clear direction.

 Experience designing inside environments you don't control - a messaging client, an extension, an embedded product - or a clear appetite for it.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Role summary 
 Bluerock TMS builds the autonomous orchestration platform that keeps global logistics moving — orchestrating complex, multi-modal transport networks for customers across fashion, food & beverage, manufacturing, healthcare, and more. Real complexity, at real scale, every single day. 
 We're looking for a Product Manager who has actually lived inside logistics or TMS operations. Someone who can understand operations complexity and who is willing to take on this challenge and contribute hands on to build the next level of TMS. You'll own the products that turn that complexity into clarity, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, sales, and implementation to make sure what we build actually gets adopted. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Product vision, grounded in real user needs 

 You dig past what customers ask for to find the problem underneath, and turn that into a direction for your area the company can rally behind. 
 Market scoping and opportunity-spotting 

 Scanning the logistics landscape, competitor moves, and customer signals to find where Bluerock should build next, not just what's already on the backlog. 
 Logistics know-how turned into product decisions 

 Planning, transport execution, freight, last-mile — decisions that hold up against how operations actually run, not just how they're described to you. 
 The full lifecycle 

 From first idea to adoption. You don't hand off and disappear. 
 The connective tissue across the company 

 When priorities compete or a customer escalation needs an answer fast, you're the one pulling the threads together. 
 
 The team you’ll join 
 You'll join an international product team with complementary skills and a shared passion for a good challenge, real, hands-on experience in logistics paired with genuine enthusiasm for technology. We don't settle for quick patches: we strive for quality, look for the sustainable solution over the easy one, and keep an eye on what next-level TMS should look like, not just what's in front of us today. 
 
 Life at Bluerock 
 We're a distributed team across the Netherlands, Italy, the US, and Canada that operates like one crew: local insight, global perspective. We're curious by default, self-driven without needing to be told twice, and genuinely joyful about solving hard logistics problems together. We're team-minded because the best answers rarely come from one person alone, and unapologetically reliable because our customers' supply chains don't get a “we'll fix it next sprint.” As one of us put it: at the end of the day, it's the people that make Bluerock. 
 
 
 5+ years in product or project management within logistics, supply chain, or TMS — hands-on TMS experience is required. 

 Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Information Systems, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field required. 

 A track record of delivering complex, high-stakes software implementations , on time and within budget. 

 Genuine ease operating cross-functionally . You connect engineering, sales, implementation, and customers without waiting for permission. 

 An appetite for ambiguity and change : a messy, fragmented workflow reads to you as an interesting problem. 

 Nice to have: API integration experience (WMS, ERP, visibility providers, customs), fluency with Agile tooling (Jira, Asana, Rocketlane), and PMP/PRINCE2 certification. 

 Excellent leadership and team management skills , with the ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams. 

 Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage customer relationships and stakeholder expectations effectively. 

 Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on delivering results in a fast-paced environment 

 
 Our hiring process 
 Hit the Apply button. 

 Join a 30 minute video call in the Introduction Interview 

 A couple of deeper interviews built to be a win-win, not an interrogation. 

 An offer, and the start of your journey with Bluerock TMS. 

 
Bluerock TMS is an equal opportunities employer. We take pride in our diverse workforce and inclusive workplace. Within a small team of open-minded talents, we ensure an attractive learning environment that you are looking for!

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (Subsea)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager (Subsea) to lead multidisciplinary projects from initiation through delivery, with a strong focus on offshore, subsea or marine-related operations.
 
 In this role, you will manage complex technical projects involving internal teams, external partners and customers. You will be responsible for keeping projects on track, managing expectations, identifying risks early and ensuring successful delivery within scope, time and budget.
 
 This is a great opportunity for someone with a strong technical background, hands-on project management experience and exposure to offshore or subsea environments such as cable laying, geotechnical surveys, marine operations or related activities. You will join a growing scale-up environment where processes are still evolving, and where your experience can directly contribute to how we mature our project management approach.
 
 What you’ll do: 
 Lead multidisciplinary projects from initiation through delivery, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope and within budget.

 Act as the main point of contact for customers, partners and internal stakeholders.

 Manage projects related to offshore, subsea or marine operations, such as subsea cable installation, geotechnical monitoring, marine surveys or similar activities.

 Coordinate closely with R&D, engineering, production, commercial and other internal teams to ensure successful project execution.

 Translate technical requirements into clear project deliverables, timelines and actions.

 Identify project risks early and implement mitigation plans to protect delivery, quality and customer expectations.

 Monitor project progress, budget, planning, scope and key milestones.

 Support bid development, technical discussions and customer relationship management where needed.

 Contribute to improving project management processes, tools and ways of working in a scaling organization.

 Capture lessons learned, share knowledge and support others in building strong project delivery practices.

 
 What’s in it for you 
 Work on products that are deployed in real-world, high-impact environments, not just concepts or internal tools

 Operate in a fast-growing, international scale-up where you can truly influence how projects are run.

 Regular team activities and shared lunches throughout the week.

 
 What we’re looking for: 
 MSc degree in Engineering, Physics, Offshore Engineering, Marine Technology or another relevant technical discipline.

 Around 5–8 years of relevant project management experience in a technical environment.

 Experience with offshore, subsea or marine-related projects, such as cable laying, geotechnical surveys, marine operations or similar.

 Strong planning, budgeting, risk management and project execution skills.

 Experience working with multidisciplinary technical teams.

 Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with customers, partners and internal teams.

 Technical affinity and the ability to understand complex technologies and translate them into practical project deliverables.

 Comfortable working in a dynamic scale-up environment where priorities can shift and processes are still being developed.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Finance App
jobs.description:
About KIRA 
 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
  
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
  
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 
 The Role 
 KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
  
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
  
 The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
  
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
  

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
  

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
  

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
 

 Location
 This is a hybrid role . You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week , with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.
 Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised..
 
 Language
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
 
 Interview Process
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round
 

 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager (Region Delivery)
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager to join our Region Delivery team. You will own the delivery of new compute regions end to end — from hardware handover through acceptance testing to production readiness — coordinating across hardware, networking, capacity, and platform engineering teams under tight timelines.

 

Your responsibilities will include

  • Owning delivery of region and GPU cluster deployment projects from kickoff through production handover

  • Coordinating the capacity acceptance procedure: validating infrastructure availability, quota allocations, monitoring/alerting, and documented sign-off before a region goes to customers

  • Coordinating acceptance testing across engineering teams (compute, storage, networking, GPU) and clarifying test ownership between them

  • Acting as the real-time escalation point during live deployments — resolving blockers such as hardware failures, provisioning issues, or capacity conflicts by engaging the right on-call teams

  • Defining and maintaining clear contracts and responsibilities between the teams involved in delivery to reduce cross-team ambiguity and friction

  • Driving continuous improvement and automation of repetitive deployment and acceptance-testing work

  • Running structured, high-signal status communications so stakeholders always know where a deployment stands

 

We expect you to have:

  • Proven experience leading technical projects or engineering teams, ideally in infrastructure, cloud, or datacenter environments

  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate across many engineering teams simultaneously and drive alignment without formal authority

  • Calm, decisive communication under pressure, including during live incidents

  • Strong bias toward clear ownership and documentation over ad hoc firefighting

  • Fluent English

 

It would be a strong advantage if you have:

  • Experience with cloud/compute capacity management or GPU infrastructure

  • Background in large-scale datacenter rollouts

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership

Role - Senior Data Remediation Project Manager 
 Location - London (Hybrid)

 About the Role: 
 Delta Capita is seeking an experienced Senior Data Remediation Project Manager to lead a high-profile regulatory and customer remediation programme within the financial services sector. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving complex data remediation initiatives, coordinating multiple delivery workstreams, and ensuring the successful execution of large-scale remediation activities impacting customer data, operational processes, and technology landscapes. 
 
 This is a highly visible role requiring exceptional stakeholder management capabilities, strong programme governance experience, and a deep understanding of data, technology, and regulatory remediation environments. 
 

 Key Responsibilities: 
 • Lead the delivery of a large-scale data remediation programme within a regulated financial services environment. 
 • Consolidate multiple data-related workstream plans into a single integrated delivery roadmap, ensuring clear dependencies, milestones, risks, and governance are maintained. 
 • Drive execution across business, data, technology, operations, and change teams to ensure delivery objectives are met. 
 • Engage and influence senior stakeholders, including Executive leadership, Programme Sponsors, Risk, Compliance, Technology, and Operations teams. 
 • Assess and manage data remediation impacts across systems, data architecture, operating models, controls, and manual processes. 
 • Provide strong programme governance, tracking delivery progress, risks, issues, and remediation plans. 
 • Identify opportunities to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve remediation effectiveness, customer outcomes, and operational efficiency. 
 • Collaborate with technical teams to understand data lineage, data quality issues, system dependencies, and remediation approaches. 
 • Ensure remediation activities are aligned with regulatory expectations, governance standards, and customer outcome requirements. 
 • Support decision-making through robust reporting, stakeholder communications, and programme documentation.

 
 Required Experience: 
 • Proven experience leading large-scale data remediation or regulatory remediation programmes within financial services. 
 • Strong project or programme management background with experience delivering complex, multi-workstream initiatives.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Accounting (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Mach aus komplexer Buchhaltungssoftware eine, die Menschen ihre Arbeit leichter macht. 
 Bei Buena kaufen wir Hausverwaltungen und entwickeln die Software, mit der sie täglich arbeiten. Dadurch sind wir direkt an den Menschen, Prozessen und Problemen, für die wir bauen.
 Buchhaltung ist ein zentraler Bestandteil dieser Arbeit. Ob Mietausschüttung, Unterkonten oder Jahresabrechnung: Abläufe müssen verständlich, Ergebnisse korrekt und Automatisierungen auch dann zuverlässig sein, wenn etwas vom Standardfall abweicht.
 Wir suchen jemanden, der Buchhaltung tief versteht und dieses Wissen in bessere Software übersetzen kann. Gemeinsam mit unseren Nutzern, Engineering und Design findest du heraus, welche Probleme wir lösen müssen, wie eine gute Lösung aussieht und wohin sich unser Accounting-Produkt entwickeln soll.
 Was du bei uns machst
 Probleme wirklich verstehen: Du arbeitest dich in die Buchhaltungsprozesse unserer Hausverwaltungen ein – inklusive Sonderfällen, fachlichen Anforderungen und bestehender Einschränkungen.

 Die richtigen Verbesserungen identifizieren: Du unterscheidest zwischen fehlenden Funktionen, unklaren Abläufen, technischen Fehlern und Fragen zur Bedienung.

 Die Produktrichtung gestalten: Du entwickelst eine klare Vorstellung davon, wie Accounting bei Buena funktionieren soll, und priorisierst Verbesserungen nach Nutzen, fachlicher Notwendigkeit und Wirkung.

 Lösungen konkret machen: Du übersetzt komplexe Anforderungen in verständliche Konzepte, Spezifikationen und Nutzerabläufe, die du mit Engineering und Design weiterentwickelst.

 Korrektheit sicherstellen: Du prüfst Lösungen, denkst Sonderfälle durch und beurteilst, ob neue Funktionen die zugrunde liegenden Anforderungen erfüllen.

 Bis zur Nutzung dranbleiben: Du begleitest Verbesserungen bis zur Einführung und überprüfst, ob sie das ursprüngliche Problem im Alltag lösen.

 Das kann eine gezielte Verbesserung bei Mietausschüttungen sein – oder die grundlegende Weiterentwicklung unserer Kontenstruktur.
 Was du mitbringst
 Tiefes Buchhaltungsverständnis: Du kannst Abläufe erklären und erkennst, wenn etwas fachlich fehlt oder nicht stimmt. Erfahrung in der Immobilien- oder WEG-Buchhaltung ist besonders wertvoll.

 Produktdenken: Du hinterfragst bestehende Arbeitsweisen, unterscheidest echte Anforderungen von Gewohnheiten und entwickelst Ideen für bessere Abläufe.

 Analytische Stärke: Du zerlegst komplexe Probleme, vergleichst Lösungswege und erkennst, welcher nächste Schritt den größten Nutzen bringt.

 Technische Neugier: Du möchtest verstehen, wie unsere Software funktioniert, und kannst Anforderungen und Abwägungen mit Engineers diskutieren.

 Klare Kommunikation und Eigenverantwortung: Du bringst Fachlichkeit, Nutzerperspektive und Produktentwicklung zusammen und bleibst an einer Lösung, bis sie praktisch funktioniert.

 Besonders relevant ist Erfahrung mit der Entwicklung oder Verbesserung von Buchhaltungssoftware. Dein bisheriger Jobtitel ist dabei zweitrangig: Entscheidend ist, dass du Buchhaltung verstehst und daraus sinnvolle Softwarelösungen ableiten kannst. Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools für Recherche, Prototypen oder Tests ist ein Plus.
 Warum du bei Buena einsteigen solltest
 Dein Fachwissen verändert das Produkt: Du arbeitest direkt mit den Menschen, die unsere Software nutzen, und siehst, was deine Entscheidungen im Alltag bewirken.

 Du ergänzt ein starkes Team: Engineering und Design bringen ihre Expertise ein. Gemeinsam könnt ihr Probleme von der fachlichen Ursache bis zur fertigen Lösung bearbeiten.

 Deine Ergebnisse schaffen Möglichkeiten: Wir wachsen schnell und geben Menschen Verantwortung, die etwas bewegen.

 Du baust langfristig mit: Unsere Mission ist, Wohneigentum zugänglicher zu machen. Gute Software und funktionierende Hausverwaltungen bilden dafür die Grundlage.

 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. 
  
 The Role 
 We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Finance App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

 Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

 Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

 Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

 Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

 Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

 Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.

 
 What We're Looking For 
 Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

 Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

 Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

 Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

 Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

 Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

 Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.

 
 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Can set direction and still go deep into details.

 Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

 Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Homepage
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.
  • Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.
  • Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.
  • Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.
  • You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.
  • You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.
  • You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.
  • You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.
  • You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).
  • You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

 Chez Bricks, on construit la façon la plus simple d’investir dans l’immobilier, à partir de 10 €. 670 000+ membres, un produit régulé (PSFP) et une même exigence sur toute l’expérience : permettre d’investir simplement mais aussi de suivre son investissement dans la durée.

 Bricks est une plateforme à deux faces : d’un côté les investisseurs , de l’autre les porteurs de projets immobiliers . Deux communautés à accompagner et faire grandir en parallèle. 

 Ce qui se passe après le financement d’un projet compte donc autant que le moment où l’on investit : qualité de l’information, transparence, suivi des projets et gestion des situations plus complexes participent directement à l’expérience des deux côtés de la plateforme.

 Quelques jalons d’une aventure assez unique : passage chez Capital (M6) en 2022, Tony Parker investisseur et ambassadeur, record européen de vitesse de levée : 5 M€ en 5 secondes, 20 M€+ en 10 jours auprès de notre communauté.

 Côté business : 176 M€ collectés en 2025, +90 % en un an et la rentabilité atteinte. Notre prochain enjeu : scaler à grande échelle sans perdre la vélocité qui fait aujourd’hui partie de notre manière de travailler.

 Chez Bricks, on attend de chacun qu’il comprenne vraiment les problèmes avant de chercher à les résoudre. L’objectif : prendre les bonnes décisions et construire des solutions utiles. 

 Sur ce poste, ton travail aura un impact direct sur la qualité du suivi des projets et sur la confiance des investisseurs comme des porteurs de projets. 

 Vos missions

 🧩 Le job 

 Tu rejoins la squad gestion des projets qui est en charge de tout ce qui se passe après le financement d’un projet immobilier.

 Aujourd’hui, Bricks gère environ 400 projets financés simultanément . Pour chacun d’eux, il faut suivre ce qui se passe sur le terrain : récupérer les bonnes informations auprès des porteurs de projets, communiquer régulièrement avec les investisseurs et lorsque quelque chose se passe moins bien, il faut savoir gérer les impayés, les pénalités et les éventuelles procédures de contentieux.

 C’est aussi ce qui fait de la gestion post-financement l’un des sujets les plus stratégiques pour Bricks . Une plateforme d’investissement ne se construit pas uniquement au moment où un utilisateur décide d’investir : elle se construit dans la durée, dans la qualité du suivi et dans la façon dont les situations plus complexes sont prises en charge.

 Le challenge n’est pas simplement de “gérer 400 projets”. Il est de construire un système capable d’en gérer demain beaucoup plus sans faire grossir l’équipe au même rythme.

 Une plateforme existe déjà et accompagne l’équipe au quotidien. Elle a atteint un niveau de maturité où les prochains problèmes ne se résoudront pas uniquement avec de nouvelles features : parfois la meilleure réponse sera produit, parfois process, parfois automatisation, parfois juridique.

 C’est là que tu interviens.

 👉 Ce que tu vas owner 

 
 Comprendre profondément le quotidien des utilisateurs internes en particulier celui de la personne qui opère nos projets au quotidien : observer, écouter, identifier les irritants et comprendre ce qui peut être supprimé, automatisé ou mieux structuré.

 Faire évoluer la gestion de plusieurs centaines de projets pour qu’elle reste fluide et scalable : priorisation, automatisation, workflows, process et outils.

 Travailler avec l’engineering pour transformer les problèmes identifiés en solutions produit lorsqu’une solution technique est pertinente.

 Aller chercher l’information là où elle se trouve : care, juridique, marketing, métier, engineering… Tu ne travailles pas à partir d’une spec parfaite, tu reconstruis toi-même le contexte.

 T’approprier des sujets parfois complexes ou réglementaires. Tu n’as pas besoin d’être juriste, mais un contrat de 50 pages ou une discussion sur un process de contentieux ne doit pas te faire fuir.

 Choisir le bon levier plutôt que la feature par défaut : modifier un process peut parfois avoir plus d’impact que développer un nouvel écran.

 Transformer chaque problème rencontré en apprentissage réutilisable : l’objectif n’est pas de traiter le problème du projet n°237, mais de faire en sorte qu’il soit mieux géré pour les centaines de projets suivants.

 Et progressivement, prendre de plus en plus d’ownership sur la stratégie et la roadmap de la squad . Le périmètre pourra évoluer fortement selon ce que tu démontres sur le terrain.

 
 👥 La squad 

 Tu travailleras au quotidien avec les équipes en charge du suivi opérationnel des projets ainsi qu’avec l'Engineering, le Product, le Growth et Marketing.
